6064630672851402752.title: More than a Nuisance
6064630672851402752.description: Goblins grow bold, picking off travelers after dark and ambushing caravans on the road. No attempt at diplomacy shows even scant promise. Violence is the only language they understand, and so we are paying those with the guts and proclivity: kill them where you meet them and make the Riverlands a safer home for all who venture here.
more: Skirmish with Goblins

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630673145790466.title: Sweep the Ruins
6064630673145790466.description: Centuries of Kaelar history lay broken and defiled. Goblins nest in our most sacred places. Defecating. Vomiting. Other unmentionable things. We pilgrims would like them brought to heel for their transgressions.
more: Punish Goblins for their Sacrilege

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630673172922372.title: Quench the Fires of Grief
6064630673172922372.description: Goblins killed my little Sunny. They chased our caravan, and she was thrown from the cart when the wheel rode over a stone. They stopped the chase to tear her apart. The light is gone from my life, and so I'll give all of my worldly possessions to anyone willing to kill them. As many as you can.
more: Avenge Sunny

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630673343905798.title: The Hunter's Burden
6064630673343905798.description: We have been an understandably disruptive force on the ecosystems here in the Riverlands. Unfortunately, we see dwindling populations of popular game like deer, which means we'll need to thin out some of the less popular (and more dangerous) wolves that also feed on them. You may keep anything you kill in this endeavor.
more: Thin Wolf Populations

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630679077060608.title: Preventative Measures
6064630679077060608.description: Though we know not the cause, wolves in the area are somehow especially susceptible to magical corruption. The packs that roam our woods nearly overflow with potential aberrations. Please cull them before they become nightmares.
more: Cull Wolves in the Woods

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630679084662786.title: Pest Control
6064630679084662786.description: I can't have a walk outside the walls with all the vicious beasts stalking around the woods. Someone take some initiative and run them off!
more: Kill Wolves or Bears in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Culler's Coffer

6064630679375773700.title: Compassion for Our Ancestors
6064630679375773700.description: I struggle with the knowledge that our ancestors have wandered the land in undeath for centuries. Please end their suffering.
more: Destroy Undead in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Adjudicator's Coffer

6064630679396155398.title: Road Ranger
6064630679396155398.description: You can't get a caravan down the roads these days without bandits shaking you down. Won't someone put them in their place?
more: Kill Bandits Throughout the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630700915228672.title: The Price of Hospitality
6064630700915228672.description: Three nights ago I took in what looked like a family struggling along the road. Said some highwaymen shook them down and they couldn't pay for a room at the inn. Well, I let them into my home and by morning, they'd run off with my wife's jewelry box. I tracked them to the hills, but won't venture in for my own sake. Someone needs to bring them to justice.
more: Kill Bandits Near the Highwaymen Hills

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630701072384002.title: The Bandit Bounty
6064630701072384002.description: By order of the Grand Marshall, we agree to pay any intrepid bounty hunters willing to destroy bandits in the name of the King.
more: Kill Bandits

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630701090078724.title: A Personal Vendetta
6064630701090078724.description: All the howling and the snarling! Gods, how I miss the cacophany of the capitol! I beg anyone, please silence the more dangerous wild things. I'll handle the smaller ones.
more: Kill Wolves or Bears in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630701105479686.title: Rest Well, Furry Friend
6064630701105479686.description: Something killed my dog. Wasn't a useful beast, but it was one of the few things I brought through the portal. Needless to say, I'm sore about it would be happy enough to pay to hear he's been avenged.
more: Kill Wolves or Bears in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630701179994120.title: Make Safe the Ruins
6064630701179994120.description: The dead walk in old places around here. We need access to them for research purposes. Please kill as many as you can.
more: Destroy Undead in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Adjudicator's Coffer

6064630701186482186.title: The Goddess' Will
6064630701186482186.description: I'm no high-ranking cleric, but that any undead should roam our holy home is an abomination. Please destroy as many as you can.
more: Destroy Undead in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Adjudicator's Coffer

6064630701193691148.title: Furs For Winter
6064630701193691148.description: I fear the freeze this year with the number of unhoused roaming Lionhold and beyond. I'm no hunter, but I can dress, skin and tan wolfhides. The air is cool enough now that you can leave the corpses where they lie. I'll track them and deal with them with my cart later.
more: Cull Wolves in the Woods

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630708137427053.title: Sightseeing: Laboratory Great Oak
6064630708137427053.description: Visit the Great Oak overhanging the Old Laboratory.
more: Visit the Laboratory Great Oak

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708339343471.title: Sightseeing: Briarmoor Farms Great Oak
6064630708339343471.description: Visit the Great Oak Northeast of Briarmoor Farms
more: Visit the Briarmoor Farms Great Oak

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708359725169.title: Sightseeing: Stoneworks Great Oak
6064630708359725169.description: Visit the Great Oak growing atop the Stoneworks
more: Visit the Stoneworks Great Oak

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708384628851.title: Scouting Mission: Nika'Brae
6064630708384628851.description: Bandits have moved into the old ruined tower of Nika'Brae, and need their capabilities scouted. You'll find the tower high on the hill north of the smithworks.
more: Reach the Center of the Nika'Brae Bandit Camp

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708436336757.title: Sightseeing: Aela Dam
6064630708436336757.description: There are some fantastic views of the ruins of the old capitol along the Hearthsong River. On the second cliff North of the dam is a particularly lovely view.
more: Visit the Cliff Overlooking the Dam

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708453834871.title: Sightseeing: Korra'Loch
6064630708453834871.description: There's an incredible view of Korra'Loch high above the danger of its goblin inhabitants. Find your way up to the Western cliffs overlooking the ruins and have a look.
more: Find the Cliffs Overlooking Korra'Loch

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708470087801.title: Scouting Mission: Korra'Loch
6064630708470087801.description: Goblins have moved into Korra'Loch's ruins. Reach the center of their camp to determine their capabilities.
more: Reach the Center of Korra'Loch's ruin

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708478804091.title: Sightseeing: Great Stone Arch
6064630708478804091.description: To the North of Korra'Loch, you'll find a wonderous rock formation: a huge arch on the hillside up there. It's worth a visit.
more: Explore the Stone Arch North of Korra'Loch

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708489551997.title: Sightseeing: Woodshop Overlook
6064630708489551997.description: You can find a great overlook atop the cliff above the Woodshop. It's worth seeing.
more: Visit the Overlook above the Woodshop

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708500693119.title: Sightseeing: Cookhouse Pond
6064630708500693119.description: Rest a spell at the pond by the cookhouse. It's placid. Enlightening, even.
more: Relax on the Dock near the Cookhouse

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708518191233.title: Sightseeing: Hideworks Great Oak
6064630708518191233.description: You'll find a magnificent Great Oak reaching high above the Hideworks. Rest amongst its roots and reflect on history.
more: Enjoy the Shade of the Great Oak above the Hideworks

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708530839683.title: Sightseeing: The Manager
6064630708530839683.description: An oak larger than I've ever seen sits atop a small hill East of the Cookhouse. We call it The Manager around here, since even the other great oaks seem like saplings in comparison.
more: Report to The Manager

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708545257604.title: Scouting Mission: Baneswood Cemetery
6064630708545257604.description: Unspeakable sounds come from Baneswood after dark. We need someone to reach as far as the shaded archways near the center of the cemetery.
more: Reach the Center of Baneswood Cemetery

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708556660870.title: Sightseeing: Gemspring
6064630708556660870.description: Gemspring is one of the Riverlands natural wonders. We know not its functions, but no adventurerer should consider their story complete until they've set eyes upon the great crystal whorl.
more: Visit the Gemspring Crystal Whorl

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708574683272.title: Ponder Spire Pond
6064630708574683272.description: You'll find a curious rock formation in the pond North and East of the Agricultural Supply.
more: Visit the Spire Pond

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708589297802.title: Sightseeing: Highwaymen Hills
6064630708589297802.description: I wouldn't get too close, but along the West side of the circle of hill we call Highwaymen Hills, you'll find a cave mouth that acts as an entryway to the old ruins. Peek in there and you can see the fort that was there before.
more: Visit the Western Cave entrance to the Highwaymen Hills

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708600307852.title: Scouting Mission: Highwaymen Hills
6064630708600307852.description: We need a look at what the bandits marshalling in the center of the Highwaymen Hills are up to. Make your way to the center of their encampment.
more: Reach the Center of the Highwaymen Hills

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708612563086.title: Sightseeing: Haunted Lake
6064630708612563086.description: Though its namesake is accurate, the ruins at Haunted Lake are a sight to behold. I'd suggest viewing it from the flat-topped rock on the lakeshore directly South of the tower.
more: Find the viewing spot south of the Haunted Lake Tower

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708622852240.title: Scouting Mission: Smuggler's Dock
6064630708622852240.description: We believe the bandits at Highwaymen Hills are using a hidden dock along the Trinnin River to stash goods stolen from river-bound caravans. See what you can find there.
more: Reach the Center of the Smuggler's Dock

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708639826066.title: Sightseeing: Ambush Island
6064630708639826066.description: Don't let the name fool you: sure it's a narrow island and a major point of crossing the Tainnin River. Sure, it's near the Highwaymen Hills. But Ambush Island is a beautiful, tranquil place on a good day, though. You should visit it. I'm not a bandit, I swear.
more: Walk the Path across Ambush Island

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708655095956.title: Sightseeing: Carphin Island
6064630708655095956.description: Carphin is a mysterious and terrifying place, but you can get a decently safe look at it from the little island South West of the city. Check out the beautiful stone circle there. Just stay away from the tower at the top.
more: Visit the Stone Circle on Carphin Island

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708665385110.title: Sightseeing: Head Crater
6064630708665385110.description: One of the Riverlands' great mysteries is the Great Head Crater. Words cannot do it justice. Visit it North of Miraleth and South of Carphin. Gaze into its crystaline eyes.
more: Gaze Into the Crystal Eyes at Head Crater

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708678230168.title: Sightseeing: Impact Site
6064630708678230168.description: There's a clear trail cut South and West away from Head Crater that I believe is key to unraveling the mystery of the giant head. Take a look and see what you might find.
more: Find the Crystaline Impact Site

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708687732890.title: Sightseeing: Eastern Stone Circle
6064630708687732890.description: You could mark a number of these curious stone circles throughout the Riverlands. Legend says they were holy places for ancient Aelans. The most prominent one lies North of Oakenbane Keep, about mid-way to Carphin.
more: Find the Stone Circle

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708701888668.title: Sightseeing: Stone Circle Cave
6064630708701888668.description: I found an incredible cave, and I think it's worth seeing. Head upstream along the creek North of Oakenbane for a ways. You'll see the cave on your right, but if you reach the creek's source under the Grasping Oak, you've gone too far.
more: Run Through The Stone Circle Cave

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630708718731422.title: Scouting Mission: Oakenbane Keep
6064630708718731422.description: Goblins overrun the premier resting place of our ancient heroes. Oakenbane Keep to the East of the old Ruins of the Capitol was once a place for revered heroes to train recruits to fill their shoes. Reach the top of the keep and bask in the shadows of the Great Ash at its zenith.
more: Reach the Top of Oakenbane Keep

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630854089768960.title: Explore: The Court of Defiance
6064630854089768960.description: New Comers and Travellers! The Court of Defiance in Lionhold is the central district that shall provide most of your trade needs. The main well here, fed from the pure waters of the Pool of Nerimeda. Be sure to resupply and before long expeditions or provide your service to the empire by reporting to the captain of the Kaelar Army's Tower Division, Captain Eudoxia Evenmoor. United we exist in deficance and work for the greater glory of New Aela.
more: Locate the Court of Defiance in Lionhold.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870717759513.title: Explore: Dunik's Dunk
6064630870717759513.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! Citizens are urged to provide patrol assistance due to a lack of knights in Aela. Go and seek the mysterious floating rocks of Dunik's Dunk. Believed to have been created during the Harbinger Apocalypse, the pond attracts cultists and renegade mages seeking to unlock its secrets. See to its security. For Greater Glory!
more: Locate Dunik's Dunk in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870754656282.title: Delivery: Seven Stars Vineyard
6064630870754656282.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: Seven Stars Vineyard. Beware! Located in hostile country. This farming haven pays double for deliveries due to the danger.
more: Deliver the Package to the Seven Stars Vineyard in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630870777004059.title: Explore: Korra'Loch
6064630870777004059.description: Scout needed for Riverlands excursion. We the Settlers Liberation seek the garrison of the 3rd Shield Division, the keep of Korra'Loch. It is rumored that the goblins are abducting settlers and taking them here for transport to the eastern Riverlands for unholy rituals. We must know it location. Only we can save us.
more: Locate Korra'Loch in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870792273948.title: Delivery: Flame and Formula
6064630870792273948.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: Flame and Formula. The tower of these alchemist is under repair. Watch for falling rocks.
more: Deliver the Package to the Formula in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630870815146013.title: Explore: Backdoor to Nika'Brae
6064630870815146013.description: Now hiring scouts for Nika'Brae. The drunkards in the taverns are speaking. There's a Backdoor into the bandit camp on Nikae'Brae! If it's true, then we might be able to slip in and ambush the horde of hooligans while they sleep. See what you can find and we'll gladly pay. Just keep this to the shadows. No need to alarm the guards. - The Court of Cloaks
more: Locate the Backdoor into Nika'Brae.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870830350366.title: Explore: Briarmoor Farms
6064630870830350366.description: Warning! Due to the rise in highwaymen, all caravans are to remain on high alert. The merchant's guild is now offering patrol pay for those adventurers that trek to Briarmoor Farms to reinforce defensive measures of the Settler Milita. Stay on Route! - The Greyshore Transporters
more: Locate Briarmoor Farms in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870846210079.title: Explore: Three Pillars
6064630870846210079.description: Fishing Report Needed. The Aelan Fishing League is looking for scouts to report on Three Pillars, a season fishing hole in the Riverlands nestled between Highwaymen Hills and the Gemspring Fount. Noted for its three mysterious stone pillars, Three Pillars is one of the Riverlands best kept secrets. If you have the time, take trek out to Three Pillars and bait your hook. - The Aealan Fishing League
more: Locate Three Pillars a pond in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870860562464.title: Explore: The Gemspring Fount
6064630870860562464.description: Hear yee! The Council of Arch Mages is now paying explorers to locate landmarks of the Riverlands, past and present. Seek now the Gemspring Fount, a mysterious vortex of arcane essence. Beware, this supernatural site attracts creaters and cultists of formidable power. Let your efforts bring knowledge to all Verrans.
more: Locate the Gemspring Fount in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870920331297.title: Explore: Thanalas
6064630870920331297.description: Discrete Scouts needed for bandit task. Numerous failed attempts have uncovered the possibility of a secret chamber beneath the ruins in the Highwaymen Hills. Scouts are to enter the depths of this bandit stronghold that is known to a handful as the ruins of Thanalas. If there is a hidden chamber beneath the ruins, we will pay to know. - The Ensemble
more: Locate Thanalas in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630870941040675.title: Explore: Oakenbane Keep
6064630870941040675.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! With most of our forces engaged in larger campaigns, the Field Marshal has approved the conscription of settler scouts. We urgently need you, the commoner, to scout Oakenbane Keep. These powerful ruins were once the site of the Military Academy. With your aid, we will one day recclaim it. For Greater Glory!
more: Locate Oakenbane Keep in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630875922956288.title: Explore: The Circle of Stones
6064630875922956288.description: Hear yee! The Council of Arch Mages calls upon the brave and bold to visit the sacred Circle of Stones. This once revered funeral grounds must be recclaimed to promote the prosperity of all returning nations. Let your efforts bring knowledge to all Verrans.
more: Locate Circle of Stones in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630875940847617.title: Explore: Colossus Crater
6064630875940847617.description: Outrider Wanted. Outrider with war history proficiency desired for discrete trek into East Riverlands. Some call it Colossus Crater others say the Lost Head. What is known is that it came to rest near Aela during the Harbinger Apocalypse. Where it came from is not your concern. Locate it, be rewarded and forget. - High Oculus of the Sighted
more: Locate Colossus Crater in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630875955920898.title: Explore: Ambush Isle
6064630875955920898.description: "There upon an isle of woe, four heroes of the Legion of Rose. A final blockade against the Golgotha horde, towing along agents of siege and sword. Cross the bridges they did not, the four braveley fought. A last stand for brave knights, Vaal, Piit, Jyn and Noll. Give your respects is forever the toll." - Chronicler Rapha of the Athenaeum
more: Locate Ambush Isle in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630875986132995.title: Explore: The Safehouse
6064630875986132995.description: Heavy coin for a scout with discretion. We seek the location of a hidden safehouse within the Highwaymen Hills. Some say it's a cave while some say it's the husk of an old farmhouse. It's perfect for gatherings of the shady kind. Find it and get paid. Speak about it and get cut. -The Court of Cloaks
more: Locate the Safehouse in Highwaymen Hills.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630876006907908.title: Explore: Tura'Loch
6064630876006907908.description: Outrider Wanted. Someone good at tracking down ruins. We seek the location of the House of Transcendant Arcana, a former school of forbidden arts rumored to be on the shores of Loch Lyneth. Do not share the location with any save our cultists. Payement upon service rendered. - High Oculus of the Sighted
more: Locate Tura'Loch in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630876019294213.title: Explore: The Astral Tower
6064630876019294213.description: Seeking Explorers! Preferebly free from charge or citizenry. Need skilled striders to venture into the wilds around Carphin in search of the remnants an ancient tower. The Astral Tower stood fast before the wondrous Tower of Carphin and once garrisoned the mystical Knights of the Astral Blade, knigh-mage defenders of early Carphin.
more: Locate the Astral Tower in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630876031483910.title: Explore: The Aristad Archives
6064630876031483910.description: Hear Yee! The Council of Arch Mages is hiring only the most skilled and profficient mercenaries for a scouting mission in the ruins of Carphin. Inside the dangerous ruins the explorer for hire should locate the Aristad Archives, reservoir of arcane knowledge and artifacts. Payment upon completion. Let your efforts bring knowledge to all Verrans.
more: Locate the Aristad Archives in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630876045901831.title: Explore: The Tower of Carphin
6064630876045901831.description: "And there before them loomed the wondrous Tower of Carphin, a monument of applied magic and testament to the power of the arcane city. Standing in the cold doom of its shadow, the group's wizard opened up the pouch he had long carried to the doorstep of the tower. A radiance of essence blinded all senses!" - Chronicler Rapha of the Athenaeum
more: Locate the Tower of Carphin in the Riverlands.

6064630876063072264.title: Explore: Sillasin's Tower
6064630876063072264.description: Strider for hire! The Order of the Giantslayers are paying anyone that can locate Sillasin's Tower, a rock formation rumored to have been the perch for the blue dragon, Sillasin the Skybreaker. It was gravely wounded fighting off the demon hordes of Golgora. Proove its existence and be rewarded. - Lokarb the Bane of Sujoma
more: Locate the Sillasin's Tower in the Riverlands.

more: Deliver the Package to the Herne's Hideworks.

6064630876090859530.title: Delivery: Eye of the Needle
6064630876090859530.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: The Eye of the Needle. The famed tailors of Sephillion have been reborn just beyond the walls of dentral Aela.
more: Deliver the Package to the Eye of the Needle.

6064630876102262795.title: Delivery: The Ardent Anvil
6064630876102262795.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: The Ardent Anvil. The smithies that forged the Moonlight weapons of the Undying War have built their workshop on the edge of bandit country. Beware!
more: Deliver the Package to the Ardent Anvil.
Lost Crate
A lone crate sits abandoned. If it has an address, you might earn some coin for delivering it.

6064630876123824140.title: Delivery: Candor's Kettle
6064630876123824140.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: Candor's Kettle. Candor has long been the survivalists chef, having served as the Master Chef of the Kaelar Army. His goods can spoil so speed is of great importance.
more: Deliver the Package to the Candor's Kettle.

6064630876135686157.title: Delivery: The Royal Rockworks
6064630876135686157.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: The Royal Rockworks. The Royal Rockworks is owned by the royal family in Sanctus. Take extra care of these deliveries.
more: Deliver the Package to the Royal Rockworks in the Riverlands.

6064630876148334606.title: Delivery: Timberclaw Mill
6064630876148334606.description: Greyshore Transporters Delivery. TO: Timberclaw Mill. A woodworker and lumberjacks paradise, deliveries here should be swift due to the great demand of resources for rebuilding the empire.
more: Deliver the Package to the Timberclaw Mill in the Riverlands.

6064630881671577601.title: Challenge of the Mycellions
6064630881671577601.description: Huzzah! Let the hunt begin! The Hunters of Herne invite all brave souls to test their mettle in the wilds of the Riverlands. Track and slay the fearsome Mycellions, fungal beasts said to rise from Verra's very depths, spreading toxic clouds. May Herne's Arrow guide you to victory! -The Hunters of Herne
more: Hunt for Mycellions in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882094678033.title: Thin the Mycellion presence
6064630882094678033.description: Hunters Wanted! To recclaim the Riverlands we must make it safe for our mills to operate. To this end we will pay any hunter that does their fair share to thin the Mycellion population within the Riverlands. Their toxic clouds have ruined farmland and killed foraging parties. They must be culled! Let's rebuild this empire together! - The League of United Tradesfolk
more: Cull the Mycellion population.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630882250260498.title: The Mycellion Crusade
6064630882250260498.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! The Field Marshal has called for a settler crusade to cleanse the Riverlands of the Mycellion threat. The loss of scouting parties and long striders has placed our outland operations in peril. Assist our knights in a righteous crusade! For Greater Glory!
more: Eradicate the Mycellions!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882265202707.title: Challenge of the Minotaur
6064630882265202707.description: Huzzah! Let the hunt begin. The Hunters of Herne welcome one and all to test their mettle in the wilds of the Riverlands. Reward and revelry goes to those that can track and slay Minotaur. These powerful and skilled fighters are known for their arena prowess. Best them in combat! May the Arrow of Herne guide you to victory! - The Hunters of Herne
more: Cull the Minotaur.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882290696212.title: Scatter the Horde
6064630882290696212.description: Minotaur skulk and work dark magics over our ancestral places. For the glory of the Kaelar Empire, run them off and let honor return to our lands.
more: Cull the Minotaur horde.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882316845077.title: The Minotaur Crusade
6064630882316845077.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! The Field Marshal has called for a settler crusade to cleanse the Riverlands of the Minotaur hordes. They once fought us on the many battlefields of the Harbinger Apocalypse and now invade to seize what is Kaelar destiny. Drive them from our land! For Greater Glory!
more: Eradicate the Minotaur invaders.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630882331000854.title: Challenge of the Ravens
6064630882331000854.description: Huzzah! Let the hunt begin. The Hunters of Herne welcome one and all to test their mettle in the wilds of the Riverlands. Reward and revelry goes to those that can track and slay Ravens. More than the typical flying rat, these bird beasts are known for their territorial nature and diving attacks. Prepare your blade and bow! May the Arrow of Herne guide you to victory! - The Hunters of Herne
more: Hunt for Ravens in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630882350071831.title: Thin the Raven Unkindness
6064630882350071831.description: Hunters Wanted! To recclaim the Riverlands we must make it safe for our mills to operate. To this end we will pay any hunter that does their fair share to thin the Raven Unkindness within the Riverlands. Their rising population has led to the destruction of many crops and spread of disease. Let's rebuild this empire together! - The League of United Tradesfolk
more: Cull the Raven Unkindness.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882366717976.title: The Raven Crusade
6064630882366717976.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! The Field Marshal calls for a settler crusade to cleanse the Riverlands of the Raven Unkindness. Rumored to be harbingers of wickedness and corruption, truth or myth, they must fall. For Greater Glory!
more: Exterminate the Ravens!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882382774297.title: Challenge of the Arachnids
6064630882382774297.description: Big Game Hunting! Do not settle for being a great hunter. Be a giant hunter and run with the ranks of the Giantslayers! Test your bravery against the fearsome Giant Arachnids of the Riverlands. Let this be the first step to titanic victories. - Lokarb the Bane of Sujoma, The Order of Giantslayers
more: Hunt for Giant Spiders in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882396930074.title: Thin the Giant Spiders
6064630882396930074.description: Hunters Wanted! To reclaim the Riverlands, we need to ensure the safety of our mills. We'll pay any hunter who can slay the Giant Arachnids infesting the area. With barns and granaries overrun by webs, settlers fear the outlands. The spiders must be culled! Let's rebuild this empire! -The League of United Tradesfolk
more: Cull the Giant Spiders

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Culler's Coffer

6064630882478325787.title: The Arachnid Crusade
6064630882478325787.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! The Field Marshal has summoned a settler crusade to cleanse the Riverlands of Giant Arachnids. Once lurking in the depths, these foul creatures have emerged, threatening our expansion. We must drive this evil back to Golgotha! For Greater Glory!
more: Exterminate the Giant Spiders!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882496872476.title: Rubblemaking
6064630882496872476.description: Reward and revelry goes to those that can crush Golems. These relics of ancient war are a challenge for the might of any hunter. May the Arrow of Herne guide you to victory!
more: Destroy Golems in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Riverlands Mercenary's Coffer

6064630882543337501.title: Purge of the Haunts
6064630882543337501.description: We call to you! Defend the Riverlands from the wicked haunts of this land. Twisted and evil Ashen Haunts have risen from the chaos of the Harbinger Apocalypse. It is the calling of the clerics to all faithful Kaelar to wage war upon these ghosts of the past. Release them from this world! Serve the Seven! - The Church of the Seven Stars
more: Destroy Ashen Haunts in the Riverlands!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Adjudicator's Coffer

6064630882554216478.title: The Skeleton Crusade
6064630882554216478.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! The Field Marshal has called for a settler crusade to cleanse the Riverlands of the Skeleton menace. Raised by wicked priests or cursed by their own evil ways, these undead creatures have fought for the Ancients and remain to plague our land. Send them to Golgora! For Greater Glory!
more: Destroy Skeletons in the Riverlands!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Adjudicator's Coffer

6064630887465943052.title: Bounty: The Stench of Death
6064630887465943052.description: Seek and slay Wormwig the goblin. This wretched goblin has been known to perform horrid rituals upon Kaelar captives. He  wreaks of death and dons the maggot filled scalps of his victims. If we cannot return them from the dead, then we shall send this creature to them. Reward to be paid. - Briarmoor Watch
more: Seek and slay Wormwig.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887490781197.title: Bounty: The Murderous Mascot
6064630887490781197.description: Wanted! Snar the wolf. Be on the lookout for Snar, the former mascot of the Tower Guard. He has gone rabid and killed multiple settlers in the Briarmoor area. He is to be slain to release him from his madness. Poor, Snar. - Captain Eudoxia Avenmoor of the Kaelar Army.
more: Seek and slay Snar.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887517585422.title: Bounty: The Thief of Theives
6064630887517585422.description: Seek and slay Brogun the Shotcaller. This whelp dared to betray the honor of the thieves' guild, pilfering from our safehouses and fleeing to the Forsaken Blades for protection. He cannot hide. Slay the wretch, and the reward shall be yours. -The Court of Cloaks
more: Seek and slay the Shotcaller.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887532396559.title: Bounty: Weblord of Golgora
6064630887532396559.description: Seek and slay Ysshokk the Weblord. This ancient arachnid is of great intelligence and was once locked within the magic prison of Carphin. Upon his escape he joined the demon hordes of Golgora in their effort to destroy the great portal. His execution is of high calling and great reward. - The Scholars Academy of Verra
more: Seek and slay the Ysshokk.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887544782864.title: Bounty: Never to be Named
6064630887544782864.description: Seek and slay the Desecrated Conscript, a revenant from ancient wars. He was once a great general, but corrupt actions cursed him to wander the graves, never to be named. The name that once brought him infamy and minions would be stricken from existence. We have ultimate mercy and call for his destruction. - The Church of the Seven Stars
more: Seek and slay the Desecrated Conscript.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887573028881.title: Bounty: Cursed By the Final Command
6064630887573028881.description: Seek and slay the Echo of Command. Ancient records speak of a mad warlord who led his knights to hunt a peaceful giant. At Titan's Ring, they cornered the giant, who begged for mercy and offered allegiance, but the warlord's final command sealed its fate. The giant's blood awakened the ring's power, and a curse fell upon the warlord and his knights, binding them to guard the site of their treachery for eternity. The curse endures, fueled by that final, merciless command. -The Striders Vigilant
more: Seek and slay the Echo of Command.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887584301074.title: Bounty: Death to the Piglet Kicker!
6064630887584301074.description: Seek and slay Riggs the River Runner. I will pay any cutter handsomely for the death of this river rat. He has been known to associate with the Forsaken Blades. That's who he traded my stash to! And no doubt, you're all next! He has been known to kick piglets too and rob old folks. End his crime spree! -The Piper
more: Seek and slay the River Runner Riggs.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887596097555.title: Bounty: The Blood Raven
6064630887596097555.description: Seek and slay the Blood Raven! According to the oracles, his continued existence brings a dark omen and a returning plague which once saw the deaths of thousands of Aelans. Be vigilant! - Field Marshal Stormrazer
more: Seek and slay the Blood Raven.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Commissioner's Cache

6064630887607894036.title: Bounty: A Mound of a Mistake
6064630887607894036.description: Seek and slay Terramound the Rock Elemental. My folly has released this force of destruction upon one of the most enigmatic research sites, the Colossus Crater. A spell a few arcane words off can make a huge difference. What was to be the removal of debris can become a violent guardian. Please correct my folly and the reward is yours. - Maldoor the Magnificent Master of Magic
more: Seek and slay the Terramound.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887618773013.title: Bounty: Chest Full of Vengeance
6064630887618773013.description: Seek and slay Hoodwinx the Hoarder. I doubt the skuttering thing even knows its been named. It's been gobling people for years. Well, I want my revenge for gobling my mate, Trosty. Top coin for the death of this ravenous beast. - Skylark the Strider of the Mistful Moor.
more: Seek and slay the Hoodwinx.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887628800022.title: Bounty: Igniting the Cinder of Mercy
6064630887628800022.description: I wish to deliver mercy to my nameless associate, a scholar of some renown in ages past. His pursuit of dark arts was forbidden and within that abyss he chose a terminus that would consume his existence, his name even. This request of mercy is the smoldering cinder only you can ignite. Set him free, for I will long be gone before this request is fulfilled, yet, your reward awaits. - Olek Bellsong of the Clockwork Council
more: Seek and slay the Doomed Researcher.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630887640399895.title: Midnight Run
6064630887640399895.description: Seek and slay Slippy Mudfoot! Be on the lookout for the goblin pest, Slippy Mudfoot. When darkness falls, the goblin has been known to rush the Northern gates of Lionhold for reasons unknown. Execute him on sight. For Greater Glory! - Kaelar Army, Tower Division
more: Seek and slay Slippy Mudfoot.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630910069571584.title: Explore: Lyneth Isle
6064630910069571584.description: The Kaelar Army Needs You! With most of our forces engaged in larger campaigns, the Field Marshal has approved the conscription of settler scouts. We urgently need you, the commoner, to scout the ruins on Lyneth Isle. Once the site of a memorial to the Lyneth Dynasty, the first rulers of Aela, it has become infested with goblins. Patrol this revered site in Aela for the safety of Lionhold and For Greater Glory!
more: Locate Lyneth Isle in Aela.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630911118475265.title: Bounty: The Pugilist Pirate
6064630911118475265.description: Seek and slay Liam "Knuckles" Popinski for taking a fall in the Lionhold pugilist championship, "The Rumble in the Ruins!" He has cost our clientele and the court a great deal. We now call for his final knockout. He is rumored to have left the city and taken up with the local bandits. Seek and slay! - The Court of Cloaks
more: Seek and slay Captain Knuckles.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911139184642.title: Bounty: From Hook to Crook
6064630911139184642.description: Seek and slay Kegan Braegor for treason. Once a loyal captain of the harpoon unit of the Anchor Division, this loyal mariner is now a high ranking member of the local bandit horde. His days of commanding the hunting ship, "The Kingfish" are over and soon his life will be at an end as well. - Field Marshal Stormrazer, Kaelar Army, Verra Expedition
more: Seek and slay The Kingfish.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911151439875.title: Bounty: Cancel the Curse
6064630911151439875.description: Seek and slay the ghostly guardian, the Bough Warden of Oakenbane Keep. Long has my familly been cursed by this haunt's existence. Long ago, when titans walked the Riverlands, this valiant warden was betrayed by my ancestor and ever since, we have been cursed for generations. Diligent research uncovered the origin and the cure to this curse. End my families corruption. Send Valora's soul to the other side! - Lord Blake Asher the 4th
more: Seek and slay The Bough Warden.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911174377476.title: Bounty: Spiritual Assassin
6064630911174377476.description: Seek and slay! While the Kaelar army and their feeble militia ignore the sacred sites of heroes, we, the Order of Giantslayers do not! Oakenbane Keep has long been a memorial and testament to giant slaying. It is the site of the greatest battle against Aelan and Titan. Oakenbane is now being defiled by the presence of minotaur and their unholy leader, a shaman known as Garumat. Slay the spiritual leader of the minotaur and bring a bit of peace to the giant slayers of the past. - The Order of the Giantslayers
more: Seek and slay Garumat the Minotaur.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911192924165.title: Bounty: Jabjab the Jubbjub
6064630911192924165.description: (Miraleth: Village Stage) Defend the faith and death to the defilers. The priests of Lionhold seeks a slayer for an Oakenbane crusade.Slay the High Jubjub, a goblin spouting tongues of evil powers taken fron the Golgorabak. We will stop the spread of such blasphemy with your help. Serve the Seven and earn your rewards here and beyond. - The Priests of Lionhold
more: Seek and slay the High Jubjub. (Miraleth: Village Stage)

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911211470854.title: Bounty: Tag the Zaag
6064630911211470854.description: Seek and slay Chief Zaag. Hey Bub! If you have the dirk we have the deed. This gobber and his brood has interfered in our graveyard "inspections". We can't have that so we'll pay any cutter that can tag the Zaag. In other words, kill him! - The Court of Cloaks
more: Seek and slay the Chief Zaags.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911223857159.title: Bounty: The Crime of Grime
6064630911223857159.description: Seek and slay the cultist known as Unclean Hands. This beast is wanted for the massacre of a nomadic priest of Tishaba. I have tracked him from the dunes of the Sandsquall to the Riverlands where he now hides among the horrors of Carphin. Seek and slay and you shall get your deserved portion of the reward. - Miska Nasir, Hasheem of the Dunes
more: Seek and slay Unclean Hands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911233228808.title: Bounty: The Hall Monitor
6064630911233228808.description: Seek and slay the Monitor. This hulking collection of pots and pans has been a thorn in my side so lets try a little bounty. Any merc or magician that can empty this canteen will be handsomely rewarded. And should you get the same offer from any grubber named Kev, be warned he hasn't the coin nor the cockles to follow through. - The Piper
more: Seek and slay the Monitor.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911243190281.title: Bounty: The Crying Eye
6064630911243190281.description: Seek and slay the Crier. Something wicked has crossed over from elseworlds. I am in urgent need of a highly skilled mercenary who knows hos way around the most dangerous dungeons. I seek to slay an ocular of the most peculiar planar origins. Called the Crier, this dangerous denizen bars my entry into a portion of the ruins of Carphin. I will pay the heaviest coin to see this monster destroyed or sent back to the realm is was called forth from. - The Great Voodini
more: Seek and slay the Crier.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630911256887306.title: Bounty: The Final Sale
6064630911256887306.description: Seek and slay the Curio Peddler of Carphin. Even in undeath, this cursed merchant continues to peddle his morbid wares. Justice must be served, whether by the astral blades of the Inkunu reapers or those he endangers with his cursed curios. Let the Seven guide you through Carphin's shadows to the bazaars where this dealer of death hides. Banish him from this world and the next, and you shall be rewarded. -Lexya Redblade of the Inkunu
more: Seek and slay the Curios Peddler.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Bounty Hunter's Coffer

6064630916142858243.title: Lost Its Howl
6064630916142858243.description: An unusual windchime hangs broken upon the tree at Arlo's Rest. It is missing a part that needs to be tracked down and returned to its place.
more: Track down the missing part needed to repair the windchime at Arlo's Rest.
A Broken Windchime
A peculiar windchime dangles from a tree showing signs of damage. A relief on the base depicts a wolf.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630916156358660.title: Explore: Of Sword and Scalpel
6064630916156358660.description: Seeker wanted. We are a collective of healers, menders and puritans who seek an ancient site of a defunct knighthood. They were known as the Kyronic Order, devout followers of Kyronu, a deity of healing. Our specialization in the healing arts leads us to seek their ancient keep that was surely razed during the Harbinger Apocalypse. It is rumored to have stood high atop a mount in the east. Whoever locates it for us shall claim a reward. - The Menders League
more: Locate the Ruins of Kyron'Dun near Oakenbane.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630916172152837.title: Explore: From Dusk till Dawn
6064630916172152837.description: Scouts for Hire. Top coin for any stomper that can locate the site of the old Aelan black market bazaar. It was said to exist within a grotto or tunnel overlooking the coast. Only open from dusk till dawn, the bazaar was a major gathering place for black market goods, forbidden arts and linguists. No questions asked and the coin is yours. - The Court of Cloaks
more: Locate Spyglass Tunnell near Baneswood.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064630990502232082.title: The Vanguard Spire
6064630990502232082.description: A guard near the Vanguard Spire has informed me that the memorial was built in honor of the first wave of settlers to return to Verra through the Gateway. He stated that some of the great gems placed onto the memorial were stolen by nearby goblin creepers. If Ishould obtain the gems, I am to return them to the Vanguard Sentry, esteemed silent watch of the memorial.
more: Return the missing gems of the Vanguard Spire.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064630996207992833.title: When In Bloom
6064630996207992833.description: I have discovered a lone grave on a tiny isle at the Lonely Grave Pond outside of Korra'Loch. The stone hints that a Moonlight Bloom floral offering can be placed at the grave "When in bloom." Such a noble deed could grant a humble reward.
more: Place a boquet of Moonlight Blooms upon the Lonely Grave.
A Weathered Grave
An old grave pokes out from the vegetation along the creek shore. You get the feeling it's not been visited for some time.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Light Star

6064631000745705473.title: The Howling Oak
6064631000745705473.description: I read a tale of a heroic wolf that fought alongside the forces of good during the Harbingers Apocalypse. It says his body was laid to rest beneath a howling oak tree. I will find this tree.
more: Locate the howling oak tree.
A Curious Book
A strange book with an ornate cover depicting a sprawling tree rests nearby.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631000926584839.title: The Blood Rune
6064631000926584839.description: I found a scholar's journal entry that indicates he is in search of a goblin rune in the Aela Ruins. If I can locate the rune first and then locate the scholar, a reward might be coming my way.
more: Find the goblin Blood Rune in the Aela Ruins.
A Stained Journal
A journal, smeared with dirt from obvious fieldwork, lies open and abandoned nearby. Perhaps there's something to learn.

rewards.name: Map of the Blood Rune
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001010208776.title: Welcome to Verra
6064631001010208776.description: After crossing through the portal from Sanctus, I've met the Gateway Sentry. These guardians of the Divine Gateway instructed me to speak with an emissary of Kaelar or Vaelune origin to guide me on my first steps within the land of Verra. They can be found outisde the Gateway Cathedral.
more: Speak with a Kaelar or Vaelune Emissary for guidance.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001058836489.title: Treasure Hunt: Boggy Ruin Rewards
6064631001058836489.description: The corpse of a treasure hunter has left me a treasure map! Although badly water damaged and torn, there is a large "X" next to a tree in the misty ruins.
more: Find the Dig Site in the bog ruins.
Treasure Map
A map to buried treasure.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001075548170.title: Bing Bong Brae
6064631001075548170.description: A songsheet in the ruins of Nika'Brae hints of hidden artifact. The song is titled, 'The Dragon's Bell" and tells of the final days of the bard monastery of Nika'Brae. It fell during the Harbinger Apocalypse, destroyed by a dragon who fought Golgora's demons to reach the Bell Tower of Nika'Brae, where he carried off the great bell. Yet, something was hidden from his dragon intellect, something taken to lair of webs!"
more: Find the hidden bard relic in a lair of webs.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001107070987.title: Put to Rest, Again!
6064631001107070987.description: After destroying a peculiar skeleton in the Aela ruins, I discovered its restless curse. Perhaps I should take the bones of Sir Carson Kaeb of Baneswood to his resting place.
more: Place the remains of Sir Carson Kaeb in his grave.
An Undead Knight
A strange skeletal knight wanders here, perhaps on an old patrol route.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001122275340.title: The Sacrifice Rune
6064631001122275340.description: I have discovered another Goblin Rune. This one appears to depict Kaelar being sacrificed at an altar. Having mapped this location, I should inform Professor Hughes, the scholar studying the runes of the goblins.
more: Give the rune map to Professor A.G. Hughes.
Unexpected Rune
A goblin rune! Professor Hughs would be interested in such a find.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001148096525.title: Top of the Arch
6064631001148096525.description: I found a lost map! It depicts a pathway through a ravine west of some ruins and up into a hill with an arch. At the top I might find the dig site.
more: Find the dig site atop the arch.
A Lost Map
A scroll case nearby contains an old map showing some nearby terrain and an enticing "X".

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
The Skull of Uulorian

6064631001180209166.title: X Marks the Spot
6064631001180209166.description: I was given an old map by a homebound settler in Lionhold. He said it is holds the treasures of the former King Aeala of, Aela? I just need to dig it up and I'm rich!
more: Follow the map.
Homebound Settler
A settler looks like he is too frightened to leave the village.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Stockade Sack

6064631001243779087.title: The Precarious Keep
6064631001243779087.description: I found a lost map! It leads east past a cemetery. It ends at ruins sliding off a hillside. An 'X' is scrawled over the precarious keep.
more: Find the dig site at the sliding ruins.
Lost map
A lost map waits to be recovered.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
The Skull of Kal'Toka

6064631001259245584.title: The Megalithic Expedition
6064631001259245584.description: Akhund Bahrani, a member of a research team from the Scholars Academy of Verra, is hiring mercenaries to rid the minotaur threat in and around the mysterious Circle of Stones. Dangerous work, indeed!
more: Clear out Minotaur from the Circle of Stones.
A Travel-worn Scholar
A wiry vaelune with weary eyes and a backpack overflowing with camping kit beckons to me.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001318031377.title: The Ring of Mourning
6064631001318031377.description: A research team from the Scholars Academy of Verra is looking for highly skilled explorers who they can hire to locate an ancient ring of stones. The scholars call this the Ring of Mourning and it has long existed in the Riverlands, however, records disagree on where or what this legend describes.
more: Locate the Ring of Mourning.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001340641298.title: Isle in the Stream
6064631001340641298.description: I found a lost map! This map leads into a vale north of Briarmoor, beyond a great arch. A stream runs through the vale, near a grand citadel. In the west end of the stream is a small isle with a dig site.
more: Find the dig site at the vale with a stream.
Lost Map
A lost map waits to be recovered.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
The Skull of Meldrin

6064631001360891923.title: Respecting the Forgotten
6064631001360891923.description: A stranger near the ruins of Aela mentioned a gravesite near Briarmoor farms that contains a forgotten hero of the Harbinger Apocalypse. He will pay me to locate it.
more: Locate the Grave of the Forgotten.
A Hooded Figure
A stranger nearby looks intent to hide his identity and seems reluctant to venture outside.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001391628308.title: The Foul Source
6064631001391628308.description: From what I can deduce, the goblin sacrificial altar at the Foul Grog contaminates the area around it through Runes of Sacrifice placed around the lake. I must destroy them!
more: Destroy the Runes of Sacrifice around the Foul Grog.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001409454101.title: The Forbidden Vault
6064631001409454101.description: A tattered scroll found in the ruins of the Astral Tower describes a secret safe located at the top of the forbidden tower of Tura'Loch.
more: Search for the concealed safe in Tura'Loch.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001427869718.title: Excellio Tri'Sanctus
6064631001427869718.description: I found a sword upon one of the spectral knights of Titans Ring. It reads, "Excellio Tri'Sanctus. Arm Un'Varrow, Deep noon." This clearly needs to be returned to its owner.
more: Return the sword, "Excellio Tri'Sanctus" to its owner.
An Enticing Sword
A skelleton wanders nearby brandishing a curious sword. It's going to waste in his sun-bleached grip.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631001449299991.title: End of the Line
6064631001449299991.description: I've encountered a Greyshore Transporter driver with a busted wagon. He asked me to track down the caravan tools. Without them and a spare wheel, he can't fix the wagon.
more: Get the Caravan Tools for Driver Evigan McCall.
A Frustrated Driver
A man wearing a pin with the symbol of the Greyshore Transporters kicks a pebble and swears at it. He paces back and forth with his hands on his hips.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631029855092736.title: The Oakenbane Overlook
6064631029855092736.description: We've heard tale of a ruined tower just North of Oakenbane. Look South from those ruins to glimpse the movements of our enemies within that old keep.
more: Locate Kyron'Dun and Climb its Ruined Tower

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Worn Riverlands Traveler's Coffer

6064631029936619522.title: Banned of Brother
6064631029936619522.description: I happened upon Meni, an exiled Minotaur near Titan's Ring. He asked me to deliver some medicine to his brother, Maho, with whom he can no longer speak. He agreed to meet him on the Eastern edge of their territory around Titan's Ring, but he does not dare get so close to the others for fear that he'll be seen with him.
more: Deliver the Minotaur Poultice
A Strange Minotaur
A pale, hornless minotaur idling nearby beckons to me.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631030037020678.title: The Laws of Blood and Kith
6064631030037020678.description: Maho, an exiled minotaur near Titan's Ring believes his brother's exile unjust. She seeks vengeance on Yuna, the Stormweaver the had him banished.
more: Complete Event: Beneath the Stone Shadows
A Discrete Minotaur
There's a minotaur hiding in some brush on the rocks here. He seems to be looking for someone or something.

6064631030192734216.title: Poison Parasols
6064631030192734216.description: Luna, an Alchemist from the Scholar's Academy, asked me to put down any of the mycelleons crowding the river. When it rains, they release spores that can poison fish and people.
more: Defeat Mycellion along Lonely Oak Creek
A Sodden Scholar
A woman takes shelter from the storm under the arch nearby. She seems distressed.

6064631035503902720.title: Stony Roads
6064631035503902720.description: Every structure needs a sound foundation, and Riverlands Basalt provides sturdy footing! The frontier needs stone to grow, gather up Basalt to lend our masons strength!
more: Mine Basalt from stone outcroppings in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631046193741826.title: Path to the Vaelune
6064631046193741826.description: I have spoken with the Emissary of Samia's Hope. If I wish to work towards becoming a member of the Vaelune Empire, I will begin my journey there.
more: Speak to an Ambassador of Samia's Hope.
A Vaelune Emissary
A man wearing a pendant depicting Sidrah's Falcon, the symbol of his people, takes newcomers' names down on a scroll that reaches his midsection.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631046205931523.title: Path to the Kaelar Empire
6064631046205931523.description: I have spoken with the Emissary of  Lionhold. If I wish to work towards becoming a member of the Kaelar Empire, I will begin my journey there.
more: Speak to an Ambassador of Lionhold.
A Kaelar Emissary
A man wearing a pin depicting the Lion of Courage, the symbol of the Kaelar, dictates the names of recently arrived migrants looking to make their way to Lionhold.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631052632915979.title: The Study of Goblins
6064631052632915979.description: I have mapped out the location of the Goblin Blood Rune found in the Aela Ruins. Now I need to locate Professor Hughes, a scholar of a goblins who is currently studying runes. He should be in a hub of knowledge and workshops.
more: Give the Rune Map to Professor Hughes.
A Crudely Carved Rock
A rock juts out from the dirt nearby etched with strange scrawls, primitive in linework but complex in pattern.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631080091975680.title: Slate Stacks
6064631080091975680.description: Our roads and rooftops need solid Slate to repel the elements in style. Teachers clamor for slate boards to teach the children letters and math! Go forth and prize new, clean slabs of Slate from Riverlands stone to fulfill these needs.
more: Mine Slate from stone outcroppings in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Commissioner's Cache

6064631080144338944.title: Proven Mettle
6064631080144338944.description: Nothing less than sweat and hard toil can free precious copper from the stones it lay within. Take up your pick and carve our shared future from the stone!
more: Mine Copper from stone deposits throughout Verra.

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631087077392864.title: Takin' it for Granite
6064631087077392864.description: Cold stone and warm hearts are what make a frontier into a home. Common, yet necessary, Granite litters the fields of the Riverlands - but it must be harvested and stockpiled to be of any use.
more: Mine Granite from stone outcroppings in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631092393279765.title: Recover Stolen Supplies
6064631092393279765.description: Bandits in the Highwaymen Hills have stolen countless numbers of our supplies. Find them and bring them back.
more: Recover Stolen Supplies

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631092485882239.title: Snuff the Ritual Fires
6064631092485882239.description: At night, goblins cackle across the ruins of Korra'loch chanting their dark rituals. Go there and extinguish their ritual flames.
more: Snuff Ritual Fires

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631159631708162.title: Aagravations
6064631159631708162.description: A forlorn spirit idling in Oakenbane Keep handed me a letter describing a toy soldier left to him in memoriam by his child. The letters "AAG" are scrawled over the letter four times in blood. It must be a reference to the names of some goblins around here.
more: Deliver the toy to the Forgotten Soldier's memorial site.
A Forlorn Shade
Some form of spirit idles nearby bedecked in ancient Aelan armor. It beckons me over.

6064631160327372830.title: Heavy Lode
6064631160327372830.description: Heavy, dull tin from Verra's stony outcroppings provides the base for a hundred household necessities. Go forth, pick in hand, and bring back a potmaker's wealth of tin!
more: Mine tin from stone deposits anywhere in Verra

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160327372877.title: Ancestral Revenge
6064631160327372877.description: Scout Yorren, charged with observing Goblin movements around Oakenbane Keep has offered to pay me if I'm willing to dispatch goblins there.
more: Kill Goblins in Oakenbane Keep
A Watchful Scout
A Kaelar scout flagged me down nearby. He might have something to tell me.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160327503903.title: Strike the Earth
6064631160327503903.description: Weaponsmiths and barmasters alike know well that their alloys need a taste of zinc to provide stability and strength. You can lend the strength of your arm to the mettle of their crafts by bringing in a bounty of zinc.
more: Mine Zinc from stone deposits throughout Verra.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Commissioner's Cache

6064631160327569440.title: Bunches and Bouquets
6064631160327569440.description: Spring has brought a bounty of blossoms from bluff to border. Daffodills drive even the most dour to delight! Gather a double bundle of these delightful blooms and deliver them briskly!
more: Harvest Daffodils from Riverlands meadows

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160327700513.title: Peddler of petals
6064631160327700513.description: The fields of the Riverlands are dotted with fluffy white snowdrops, perfect for decoration, perfumery, and even the rare comestible! Venture into the wilds and gather these plentiful blooms, you're sure to be rewarded.
more: Harvest Snowdrops in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160327766050.title: On the line
6064631160327766050.description: It's fritter season in the Riverlands! Our waterways teem with majestic bluegill, and the time is nigh to fill our creels with fish!
more: Fish up a passel of Bluegill in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160327831587.title: Riverlands' Bounty
6064631160327831587.description: Strong red-fleshed salmon wend their way from the seas to the headwaters where they spawn. Such bounty mustn't be overlooked! Harvest the wealth of the Riverlands to feed our families!
more: Fish Salmon from lakes and streams in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160344477732.title: Reeling in the Riverlands
6064631160344477732.description: The waterways of Verra are blessed by an abundance of largemouth bass, much to the delight of Riverlands anglers. Fish up a healthy collection of these gawping beauties, maybe you'll break a local record!
more: Fish Largemouth Bass from lakes and streams in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160350244901.title: Blood and Stone
6064631160350244901.description: Deep within Verra's mantle, droplets of essence combine with the stuff of the world itself under great pressure and heat to create Verran rubies - useful for both artiface and aesthetic pursuits. Mine these jewels from stone deposits wherever you find them.
more: Mine Rubies from stone deposits throughout Verra.

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160352800806.title: Axes for Allies
6064631160352800806.description: The Ash grow thick as wheatgrass on the Riverlands hillsides. Stout and sturdy timbers shade our roadways when they could hold up our rooves and barns. Fell Ash trees that you may contribute to building out our proud frontier!
more: Fell Ash lumber in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160357912615.title: Bark and Barrels
6064631160357912615.description: The evergreen boughs and thorny cones of the Eastern Hemlock work wonders at driving musty smells and moths from dank spaces. Well-to-do courtesans prize the wood for their wardrobes and bedroom panelling. You can help the artisans of the Riverlands by procuring a stockpile of this aromatic lumber - grab your axe and be off!
more: Fell Eastern Hemlock lumber in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160357978152.title: Boughbreaker
6064631160357978152.description: The tall oaks shade meadow and pond, having grown tall over long ages. Our craftsmen hold oak above most others for the construction of freeholds and the caravans that service them. Do your part to advance their craft by bringing in precious oaken lumber, harvested nearby.
more: Collect Oak lumber in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631160358043689.title: In the Arms of the Arborists
6064631160358043689.description: From the crackle of a hearth-fire to the roar of the bellows, craftsfolk need fuel. The Western Larch is well-loved for its sweet smoke and hot flames, and providence has seeded these beloved boughs all across our Riverlands. Bring forth your axe, and bring home some Larch lumber.
more: Harvest Western Larch

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631171418161152.title: On the Shelf
6064631171418161152.description: I found a lost map! The area depicted borders the Baneswood Cemetery. The dig site rests along the cliffline just west of a tunnel.
more: Find the dig site near Baneswood Cemetery.
Lost Map
A lost map waits to be recovered.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
The Skull of Larisia

6064631188364722176.title: Lost Crate: Thornmarch Tower
6064631188364722176.description: Having found a Lost Crate in the wilds of the Riverlands, I've decided the proper action is to complete the delivery to Thornmarch Tower.
more: Deliver the Lost Crate to Thornmarch Tower.
Suspicious Crate
There is a crate nearby that looks oddly out of place.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631188392181761.title: Lost Crate: Briarmoor Estate
6064631188392181761.description: Having found a Lost Crate in the wilds of the Riverlands, I've decided the proper action is to complete the delivery to Briarmoor Farms.
more: Deliver the Lost Crate to Briarmoor Farms.
Suspicious Crate
There is a crate nearby that looks oddly out of place.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631188398342146.title: Lost Crate: Nerimeda Crossing
6064631188398342146.description: I've discovered a Lost Greyshore Transport Co. Crate. As I promised Freight Boss Vaigen in Lionhold, I will deliver and Lost Crates to the client listed on it. This will be a great way to earn some coin and possibly obtain work that offers greater rewards.
more: Deliver the Lost Crate to Nerimeda Crossing.
Suspicious Crate
There is a crate nearby that looks oddly out of place.

6064631188404830211.title: Lost Crate: Monolith Grove
6064631188404830211.description: Having found a Lost Crate in the wilds of the Riverlands, I've decided the proper action is to complete the delivery to Monolith Grove.
more: Deliver the Lost Crate to Monolith Grove.

There is a crate nearby that looks oddly out of place.

6064631188409352196.title: Lost Crate: Baneswood Tower
6064631188409352196.description: Having found a Lost Crate in the wilds of the Riverlands, I've decided the proper action is to complete the delivery to Baneswood Cemetery.
more: Deliver the Lost Crate to Baneswood Cemetery.
Suspicious Crate
There is a crate nearby that looks oddly out of place.

6064631188412301317.title: Lost Crate: The Caravan of Curiosities
6064631188412301317.description: Having found a Lost Crate in the wilds of the Riverlands, I've decided the proper action is to complete the delivery to the mystrerious Antiquitor.
more: Deliver the Lost Crate to the mysterious Antiquitor.
Suspicious Crate
There is a crate nearby that looks oddly out of place.
