Compared with the sickly variety near Lionhold, these goblins are more resourceful and more menacing. They cause trouble for the Kaelar settlers traveling between Briarmoor and its neighboring farmholds. Try as they might, the Kaelar patrols have trouble keeping the roads safe from their constant mischief. At the lakeside, it appears that a scuffle has taken place between a guard and a goblin ambush. In an endeavor to recover their footing, Kaelar allies rally at the Thornmarch Guard Tower.
more: Recover the guard's belongings.
Stationed on the Road
A tower guard with a brightly gleaming broadsword stands at attention. He glances over with a worried expression on his face.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631703200792879.title: Tools of the Trade
6064631703200792879.description: I've made a deal with the wanted burglar, Splint. In exchange for retrieving his gear from the Highwaymen locker boxes, he will give me a cut of the riches found in the vaults that rest deep within the ruins of Thanalus.
more: Retrieve Splint's theives gear
Unusual Bandit
Nearby, a bandit is acting unusual, not like the others at all.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631704080941165.title: Report to Briarmoor
6064631704080941165.description: The tower at Briarmoor is responsible for handling the command out to the guards posted further down the roads leading out of the gateway. As more deserters flock to the highwaymen outposts, they take resources with them to the garrison. The Kaelar officials, swamped as they are, recruit more of the newly arrived to join them at the central farm. As long as there's proof of heroics, they'll have no choice but to listen. A thick stack of insignias should do the trick.
more: Vouch for your merits as a soldier.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631715291332839.title: The Key to Thanalus
6064631715291332839.description: The relic known as the Stone Rose is the key to the secret treasures of Thanalus. It has been revealed that they were recovered and given to a Chronicler of the Scholars Academy. I must track down this scholar and the Stone Rose if I hope to unlock the secrets of Thanalus.]
more: Recover the Stone Rose
Old Friend
An old friend lingers nearby.

rewards.name: The Stone Rose

6064631719948124273.title: Last Account of Krudd the Chronicler
6064631719948124273.description: I've found a binder belonging to Krudd the Chronicler. It's missing pages. If I find the pages maybe I will reveal his whereabouts as well as the location of the Stone Rose.
more: Find the missing pages
Damaged Journal
A weather worn and torn binder is lost in the field.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631719953236082.title: The Hide Words
6064631719953236082.description: I've found a hidious form of text, the minotaur word hide! If I can decipher the glyphs, I might reveal the location of the Stone Rose. The glyphs are similar to those of the goblins.
more: Decipher the glyphs in the Minotaur Hide Word.
Odd Minotaur Hide
A minotaur hide appears to contain an odd form of script.

rewards.name: Minotaur Hide Word

6064631743064113153.title: In a Twinkling, an Eternity
6064631743064113153.description: An oddly damp note begs you to put down the Ashen Haunts on Carphin Isle in order to avenge the people that they have shapeshifted into Hoarders long ago.
more: Defeat Ashen Haunts on Carphin Island.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631745945010176.title: A Bloody Homecoming
6064631745945010176.description: In what felt like a matter of heartbeats, I've left Sanctus and the world I knew behind and come to Verra. The situation here is dire, though, with sickly-looking creatures throwing themselves at the temple ruins with reckless abandon. I need to get to safety to get my bearings.
more: Explore your new home
A Nervous Cleric
A nervous kaelar man ducks at every shout and clatter of weapons in the battle just outside the gateway temple, though he manages to wave you over.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631749113480422.title: The Seeds of Eranthia
6064631749113480422.description: The minotaur have seized the ruins of Thanalus and I've made an alliance with the leader of the Highwaymen. Glogora has warmed over! According to the Highwayman, the bandit king, the minotaur are after the Seeds of Eranthia, the essence infused seeds from the enchanted foret of the ancient Pyrians. I must find a way to infiltrate the ruins and retrieve the seeds before the minotaur claim them for whoever or whatever pulls their strings.
more: Find a way to obtain the Seeds of Eranthia
Mysterious Bandit King
An eigmatic bandit is plotting his moves to retake the hills.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631760146464955.title: A Strange Watchman
6064631760146464955.description: It's past bedtime in the Baneswood Forest, but the watchman at the tower keeps vigil throughout the night. He offered up his lamp to light the lanterns along the paths, since they will keep the wild beasts away and guide any citizens to safety, as long as they remain lit. He warned me about some strange occurrences recently, so I should look out for anything out of the ordinary. In other words, anything that would raise concern for the residents of Hunter's Hill.
more: Light the lanterns in Baneswood.
Baneswood Road Tower
A watchman shivers in the dark at his lonely post. He makes odd animal sounds perhaps to pass the time.

6064631765640087642.title: The Lonely Shrine
6064631765640087642.description: I happened upon a lonely and forgotten shrine. Amidst the ancient grounds I encountered a mysterious entity called the Cryptmonger. This peculiar being has hinted that there is a great reward for those who can reveal the tale behind the lonely shrine.
more: Reveal the lore of the Lonely Shrine.
Frightening Creature
Lingering in the mist and darkness, something awaits.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631766193606623.title: Horns of the Betrayers
6064631766193606623.description: The Lonely Shrine is the resting grounds for a minotaur hero of Aela. He fought against the demons of Golgora, but was ultimately betrayed by his own marauders. The only way to appease his restless spirit is to retrieve and burn the horned skulls of the betrayers, his three minotaur generals.
more: Retrieve the Three Horns of Betrayers
Frightening Creature
Lingering in the mist and darkness, something awaits.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
The Oubliette

6064631766199046112.title: Containing the Rage
6064631766199046112.description: Vultauro the Bull and his horde have risen as rage filled revenants. The Cryptmonger has instructed me to acquire an unusual orb to capture the infernal force of the Bull. This action will require destroying the risen rage of Vultauro, but to do that I will have to crush his horde first. Once the rage is contained, The Bull will be free from torment, so the Cryptmonger states.
more: Capture the rage of Vultauro
Frightening Creature
Lingering in the mist and darkness, something awaits.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631794173084277.title: Academic Pursuit
6064631794173084277.description: Locate the representatives of the Scholar's Academy in the Southern Riverlands
more: Ra'aqir has tasked you with informing his colleagues in the Scholar's League about the Minotaur camps in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631822830534656.title: That Country Spirit
6064631822830534656.description: Rhondo Hornersharp has asked that you acquire a sample of Essential Water from Daragal's Famous Well.
more: Travel to Deregal Estate and seek the Implements of the Lords of Deregal.
Rhondo Hornersharp

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631827314376704.title: Relics of the Wreckless' Crew
6064631827314376704.description: You've found an artifact from the legendary river-pirate ship, The Wreckless. Allegedly sunk while sheltering in the lake near Carphin.
more: Deliver the artifact to the final resting place of The Wreckless.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631868681420800.title: The Forsaken Defiance
6064631868681420800.description: Caravans are being intercepted while traveling East of the Halcyon gates. The most likely culprits are the Forsaken Blade, a disciplined group of bandits who have taken over the Citadel of the Steel Bloom. While the real Steel Bloom Knights are considered ancient history, a new order arises among the desperate and angry hillfolk, and it's worth investigating what their motivations are against the Kaelar Empire. None of them are likely to be virtuous or sensible. Fighting back will require subverting their efforts to impede the Kaelar people, such as taking down their traps, wearing down their numbers, and stealing back the supplies they owe.
more: Become an enemy of the Forsaken Blade
Delayed Shipments
A group of guards in Kaelar uniform stand at the bridge. They keep searching down the road East for a caravan that isn't arriving.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631868686532609.title: Woe of Xander
6064631868686532609.description: The Kaelar Empire prepares to storm the gates of the Citadel of Steel Bloom, but some questions remain unanswered about the intentions of the newly formed Forsaken Blade. While many among the Halcyon Guards remain loyal to the Kaelar crown, a growing number have deserted their training. While majority opinion may dismiss the rebellion's beliefs to be alarming and unjustified, too many have fallen under their persuasion. The investigation continues in Gravepeak, where the Forsaken Blade are raiding tombs for supplies. Travel to Gravepeak to restore any damage done to the memories of Aelan ancestors, and punish the criminals who stray further and further from the Exalted path. The Forsaken Blade who abandon the Kaelar Flag are also abandoning the sacred past of their people by desecrating the graves of Xander. Despite their vandalism, it may still be possible to recover lost history by restoring the damage done to the gravesite.
more: Recover the graves of the Xander House
House of Xander Family Crest
The Forsaken Blade have formed a detachment of orderlies to surround the family crypt.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631868689088514.title: Flowers Along a Trail
6064631868689088514.description: Surrounded by enemies on all sides, the Forsaken Blade are in a losing position at the Citadel. While they requisition further stolen supplies from the Kaelar, they exploit the Hillfolk as a means of surviving. Cutoff from the values and principles of the people they deserted, the Forsaken Blade have lost sight of their principles as a disciplined soldiers. From within their fortified tower, a devious and charismatic General commands a growing group of dissenters who are quick to execute on his cruel demands. While the Hillfolk are just as desperate and angry, some of them are willing to cooperate on the grounds of self-preservation. It will require a bit of clever legwork to extract more information on the movements of the Forsaken Blade. So long as heroes persist, however, their wrongdoings will not go unnoticed.
more: Gather information from the Hillfolk

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631868690464771.title: The Merciless General
6064631868690464771.description: The Forsaken Blade's methods grow increasingly cruel in an effort to garrison the Citadel of Steel Bloom. There are signs they are unsatisfied by the alliance with their weaker bandit counterparts, and their ambitions may be larger than the loyalists ever expected. If they seek the power of the Sighted, will the cultists be persuaded to support the rebellion against the Kaelar Army? Such a terrifying alliance might still be prevented and the civilians of Halcyon saved from doom if disharmony stands in the way of two factions working together. It's up to the people of Halcyon to find ways to shake doubt into the potential alliance forged between the Sighted and the Forsaken Blade. The mistrust between them must grow before the Kaelar can take any further action toward besieging the citadel.
more: Sow discord between the Forsaken Blade and the Sighted.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631868691841028.title: Staunch the Bloody Blade
6064631868691841028.description: Tensions rise between the Kaelar royalists and the rebellion gathering at the Citadel of the Steel Bloom. As suspected, the Forsaken Blade have been stockpiling more than just weapons. The supplies headed for Halcyon have been cut off altogether. The seized Kaelar caravans have been destroyed and their cargo transported to the old stronghold. To make matters worse, all signs point toward an alliance with the Sighted, the dark worshippers on a cryptic mission. Halcyon trembles with fear as it becomes surrounded on all sides by their enemies and their enemies' powerful friends, all of whom wish that they meet their bitter end. Whatever schemes have been concocted by the Forsaken Blade are bound to be cruel and twisted beyond the imagination of their former selves. As the Kaelar Army prepare to assault the citadel, it would be wise for Commander Eudoxia to gather as much reconnaissance as possible on what's ahead.
more: Investigate the Infirmary

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631873892581378.title: Seven Save Us!
6064631873892581378.description: Seven Save Us! This Kaelar exclaimation has its roots in an ancient tale carried on only by the devout followers of the Church of the Seven Stars. High Priest Lorik has provided me with a sacred hymn that holds the passage which told of the fate of the Cathedral of the Seven Stars. With this as my guide, I hope to prove the actions recorded centuries ago.
more: Investigate Hymn 7:7 Seven Save Us
Devout Priest
A holy man is gesturing blessing upon the land and speaking in tongues.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631879771423309.title: Of Wicked Intent
6064631879771423309.description: I've looted a strange key from a skulking cultist in the ruins of the Cathedral of the Seven Stars. The cultists seem to be collecting ancient relics of evil origin. Perhaps this key will unlock the purpose behind their dangerous expedition which, I am sure, is of wicked intent.
more: Find out why the cultists are at the cathedral
Dead Body
You smell something putrid and hear rats skittering about, gnawing on flesh!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Hymn 7:8

6064631906676178944.title: The Seventh Soul
6064631906676178944.description: A soul needs to be freed from eternal suffering. That soul hides in the Cathedral of the Seven Stars. According to Hymn 7:8, a Knight-Commander faced a fiend from Golgora high atop the cathedral. Instead of death, he was granted eternal suffering. They say his corrupted soul rises when the six before have fallen. Only then will he appear and death can be brought to the Seventh Soul.
more: Destroy the corrupted soul of Knight-Commander Darrow

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631908516495362.title: Come, Soft Rain
6064631908516495362.description: At the behest of Rhondo Hornersharp you have been asked to deliver a sample of Essential Water to his prospects in the Western Riverlands.
more: Deliver a sample of Essential Water to Hornersharp Farm.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064631924500070400.title: Honor the Brave
6064631924500070400.description: I wish to help the Arch Purfier by performing the anceint ritual known as the Rite of Kyronic Ashes. By performing this rite upon the bones of the undead purifier souls, we can Honor the Fallen.
more: Toss a Fallen Purfier Skull in the Ashen Pyre
Tome of Ancient Rites
The sound of fluttering pages is heard as tome of guidance waits to communicate its wisdom.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Recipe: Purifier's Guantlets

6064631985837375895.title: Pride After the Fall
6064631985837375895.description: The Kaelar have established a meager holding just inside the walls of the old Aelan capital with some primitive industry and security. Commander Eudoxia Avenmoor has asked me to get my bearings and find some way to help out around town.
more: Find a way to help out around Lionhold.
A Shining Officer
A tall woman in ornate, shining armor speaks imperiously to a subordinate. She spares you a glance and waves you over.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632020613922822.title: Title
more: Destroy Undead in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632021723643935.title: Tribal Trouble
6064632021723643935.description: The goblin tribes run amok, their numbers unchecked. The Mayor has decreed them a threat to the settlement. Go and remove them, drive them from our lands and be rewarded with peace.
more: Defeat goblins in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632021749465120.title: Haughty on the Highway
6064632021749465120.description: The Mayor has decreed that any that ply the roads near our settlements be subject to inspection and those found to be vagabonds and highwayfolk are to be expunged from the land with haste.
more: Defeat bandits in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632021767684130.title: Dust and Bones
6064632021767684130.description: Bonebinder Goblins squeeze unlife from the lingering magics left behind in corpses. Their numbers grow in the ruins of Daragal Estates, and the ill-winds of their magics wash over our lands. Destroy their cursed throngs, by decree of the Mayor.
more: Defeat Bonebinder Goblins in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632025983811608.title: Worms and Wet
6064632025983811608.description: The Mayor, in their inestimable wisdom, has noted the rise of the Gravehide Goblin Tribe in the eastern Riverlands. These bestial pests root in charnel piles, live in garbage, and spread filth throughout the width and breadth of our home. Drive the vermin out.
more: Defeat Gravehide Goblins in the Riverlands, East of the Trinnin River

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632026046136345.title: A Howl in the Wild
6064632026046136345.description: The Mayor has been warned by caravaners and hunters alike that our settlement is threatened by a thriving wolf population in the woods nearby. This is a call to action for any and all, thin the numbers of wolf packs in the Riverlands.
more: Hunt wolves in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632026087227418.title: Unbearable
6064632026087227418.description: The Mayor has decreed that bears are in season! Large or small, fierce or gentle snuffler of berries, the bears have got to go, by Mayoral decree! Hunt bears in the Riverlands for a hefty bounty.
more: Hunt bears in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632026427949056.title: Claw and Fang
6064632026427949056.description: A long and productive spring has given rise to a sharp increase in the population of woodland predators. Bears, Wolves, and Grem abound in the deeper woods of the Riverlands. The Mayor decries this threat to the hunters and foragers of this settlement, assist them by clearing the woods of these beasts.
more: Hunt bears, wolves & grem in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632026685702156.title: Bounty of the Season
6064632026685702156.description: Your Mayor calls for aid! This season has proven fruitful, and the lands lay heavy with flowers, herbs, fruits and greens just waiting to be plucked. Our neighbors have no doubt also noticed this bounty, and will be harvesting and laying away as much as they are capable of. We should not be outdone, gather the bounty of the season for your settlement.
more: Gather herbs, fruits, and vegetables anywhere in the riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632026771882001.title: Suddenly Sawdust
6064632026771882001.description: This settlement is in need of stout beams and long-burning fuel in order to grow. The Mayor has thus decreed that legions of lumber workers take to the woods nearby. Clear cut the forests, in the name of urban growth. Your Mayor decrees it! Riverlands Lumber Accepted: Oak, Ash, Braidwood, Weeping Willow, Western Larch
more: Harvest lumber in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632027070857244.title: Slippery Stones and Silvery Scales
6064632027070857244.description: By order of our Most Honorable Mayor, we bid you stock your personal larders with fish to gird our citizenry from the flensing of famine should our fortunes change.
more: Catch Fish in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632027133378589.title: Hauls of Stone
6064632027133378589.description: Your Mayor is concerned with the safety and security of this settlement. Nothing is more stout than stone, and this place will need a lot of it. The Riverlands is chock-a-block with stone, all well suited to construction. Riverlands stones accepted: Basalt, Granite, Gniess, Slate, Wyrdstone, Limestone
more: Mine stone anywhere in the riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632027187445797.title: Help us help you!
6064632027187445797.description: Everyone can be of service to their Mayor! Gain skill with basic gathering skills so that you, too may do your best to help your settlement grow. Refine your skills by gathering Daffodils, Basalt, and Copper from the Riverlands. Keep the spoils and grow your wealth along with your worth!
more: Practice your gathering skills in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632027307507758.title: Strategic Denial
6064632027307507758.description: Our rivals reach for the stars, the din of their labor has reached the ear of your Mayor, and they respond in kind. Stride far across the breadth of the Riverlands and find any metal or stone suited to industry. Take it all, just to deny our foes.
more: Collect stone and metal throughout the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632032356270278.title: Enemy Mine
6064632032356270278.description: Your Mayor commands action. Other settlements clamor for growth, and their successes make our own achievements pale in comparison. Fortunately, your Mayor has decreed that you go and bolster our stores, while likewise hindering the growth of other settlements. After all, there is no need to mine when there is stone in markets the world across. Riverlands stones accepted: Basalt, Granite, Gniess, Slate, Wyrdstone, Limestone
more: Return stone to your settlement.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632032512114892.title: Stakes in the Ground
6064632032512114892.description: Your Mayor has seen a need for sturdy lumber to drive the growth of our settlement. It need not be newly hewn, nor even rightly your property, as long as the lumber makes it into our stores in the end. Riverlands Lumber Accepted: Oak, Ash, Braidwood, Weeping Willow, Western Larch
more: Return Lumber from anywhere in the Riverlands.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632032547569873.title: Amidst the Groves
6064632032547569873.description: Your Mayor knows well the dangers of the Arboreal Spider. These creatures live high in the trees, remaining unseen and unnoticed until their homes are destroyed by rampant logging. Then they suddenly swarm, overwhelming hapless lumberfolk. Go find their haunts, and thin their numbers.
more: Hunt and Kill Arboreal Spiders in the Riverlands

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632032629424340.title: Keeping an Eye On the Neighbors
6064632032629424340.description: Perhaps the most valuable resource is information. Your Mayor requires reconnaissance of the Riverlands, and the road is long. Are you up to the task?
more: Visit each of these locations and get a good look at what is happening at each.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632033543061513.title: CalloutOnly_HathamCrowe
more: A rough-looking man flags you down as you pass.

6064632033787445252.title: Callout_CommissionHarold
more: Get yer commissions here!

6064632056178868237.title: Callout_NoCom_QuartermasterDunne
more: A stern-looking man with a furrowed brow combs over a scroll.

6064632056189747215.title: Callout_NoCom_ClericPetrah
more: A woman in cleric's garb stares absently at a strange, glowing shrine.

6064632057375556069.title: CalloutOnly_LisabethWard
more: Hurry on to Lionhold. And clean off any goblin filth before you get there.

6064632057413435879.title: The Sweat of Your Brow
6064632057413435879.description: The United Tradesfolk are dedicated to improving skills and commerce amongst the new arrivals from Sanctus. I can learn some important skills while helping them out.
more: Tradesmanager
A workman, likely a trade manager, waves at you with a broad grin.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632057872646810.title: Doing Your Part
6064632057872646810.description: A "Billmaster" that maintains the commission boards has asked me to help out by taking odd jobs. It could be a good way to make money and hone my skills.
more: An eager old veteran
New commissions posted on the hour!

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064632059014217728.title: Ceaseless Cackles
6064632059014217728.description: Goblins swarm over the ruins of our old capital, and from my room I hear the echoes of their laughter all the night long. Please silence them for me.
more: Silence Goblins

6064632694335733776.title: A New Order
6064632694335733776.description: A group of trailblazers set off on a new charter: to explore Sephilion's warehouses and return with its ancient valuables. While there isn't much information to go on, the crew members know that the treasures they seek are well sought after by many competing adventurers. They must win the race to riches in order to return investment on their bonds. The New Aela Foundation, the philanthropists who provided such generous funding, continue to charter missions into Verra based on the special interests of a wealthy elite. Their lofty goals are crystal clear: to establish a new class of settlers and rebuild political influence on the rest of the riverlands. On the other hand, those contracted by the Foundation: former thieves, misfits, and hustlers attempt to clear their name with a clean job. But first, they must deal with the immediate problem of how to find their way through the haunted districts left behind by the apocalypse.
more: Meet Galein's crew and collect information on Sephilion.

6064632700184166575.title: Ace in the Hole
6064632700184166575.description: Find Sweeney and bring back the rest of the manifests.
more: As the adventurers rally their resources and come up with a plan, they grow anxious while awaiting the last member. As the strongest and most talented trailblazer among them, Sweeney "the Dealer" is a born fighter. With dagger in one hand, and sword in the other, she slices through New Aela charters like no one has seen before. They say it's the lucky gold hoop earring they wear, and the others hope that luck never runs out. Since they split ways at their previous camp, the team retraces their steps to where this whole mess began. According to Dwayne, they had assigned their duties over the outcome of a game of cards. As the loser that day, Sweeney is reported to be holding onto their funding for safekeeping. But since they've been missing, the others fear that they might have made the worst decision yet. Sweeney may have run off, or worse still, they may be in grave danger.

6064632700184297648.title: Distant Relatives
6064632700184297648.description: All across the Riverlands, the ghosts from the past reawaken. They direct their anger at the Exalted descendants who disturb their stomping grounds. The early settlers make an attempt to retrieve as many of the precious artifacts, documents, and treasure as possible, but many have no choice but to retreat. One such scholar, a displaced mage, pointed me toward his home, the Honorsworn Tower, where he had been quietly studying from its ancient libraries. That is until recently, when he became rudely evicted by haunts. While some argue over the law of property in the afterlife, others seize what's theirs by right of force. Perhaps if more manifests are recovered from the tower, Emiguel the Bookkeeper will make good use of them. Besides, he will have to hear the bad news concerning Sweeney's disappearance and he might not take it so lightly. Unless, of course, the manifests are replaced. The concern remains, however, the deceased return from their graves and prevent newcomers from trespassing upon their ancient cellars.
more: Recapture lost possessions from the Honorsworn Tower.

6064632733240262784.title: Cleaning the Books
6064632733240262784.description: With the preliminary research completed, the trailblazers find themselves a few steps ahead of the competition. The search party makes arrangements to meet back at the nearest town, where settlers have begun to construct the first semblances of a new civilization. As a symbol of hope for the future, they break ground on fertile soil not too far from the edge of Sephilion itself. From that very overlook, the first citizens take in a new view. In the distance, the golden gates of Sephilion peer out of the fog. And the brave and bold might begin to imagine what awaits them just beyond the precipice.

6064632953970884611.description: The stately trunks and feathery fronds of the Date Palm provide not only sweet fruit but also timber of unmatched versatility. Revered by coastal builders, its wood shapes sturdy piers and sleek hulls for river barges. Contribute to their noble trade by gathering a supply of this prized palm wood, take up your tools and head for the groves!

6064632953982418948.title: Tenacious Timber
6064632953982418948.description: The resilient acacia stands firm in sun-scorched sands, its golden-hued wood valued for its strength and beauty. Skilled artisans prize it for crafting robust wagons and elegant furnishings that endure through the ages. Play your part in their endeavors by harvesting this precious acacia timber from the nearby dunes..
more: Harvest Acacia lumber in the Sandsquall Desert

6064632953988972549.description: The towering arms and spiny ribs of the Saguaro Cactus are a desert treasure, their sturdy skeletons prized for crafting rustic furniture and striking decor. Wealthy merchants seek the cacti dried frames to adorn their grand halls with a touch of the arid wilds. You can aid the desert artisans by gathering a haul of this iconic cactus wood, sharpen your blade and venture into the sands!

6064632954121879558.description: Fields of vivid amber sway gently in the breeze, as poppy plants bloom in vibrant splendor. Their petals are prized for their beauty, while their seeds and sap hold both culinary and medicinal value. The apothecaries and perfumers await your harvest, gather a hearty bundle of poppies and bring them quickly to town!

6064632954123976711.description: The vibrant hues of the Paintbrush plant stand out like strokes of a master artist, its fiery red blossoms sought after for their striking beauty and potent pigments. Crafters and artists across the land eagerly await this treasure to bring color and life to their creations. Brave the fields and gather these brilliant blooms, for they are sure to fetch a handsome reward.

Whether for crafting durable ropes or brewing refreshing beverages, its usefulness is unmatched. Journey into the wilds to gather this resilient plant; the rewards of your labor will surely be plentiful.

6064632954189905929.description: The golden hues of Sandstone evoke the sunlit dunes where it rests, its smooth texture perfect for crafting sturdy walls and grand facades. Though abundant in the arid regions, it takes hard work to quarry and prepare for use. Help lay the foundation for future settlements by gathering and stockpiling this essential building stone.

Venture into the shadowed crags to gather Obsidian for our craftsmen!

6064633669157192475.title: Deliver a Caravan
6064633669157192475.description: Deliver a caravan to its destination.

6064633691660157067.title: Testing New Buff Distribution
6064633691660157067.description: We must gather supplies if we are to go to war with another node.
more: Donate batches of 20 T1 gatherable materials to fund the war effort. Turn in at the commission chest in the node.

6064633729694760960.title: A Chilling Report
6064633729694760960.description: Runescribe Flinthelm has compiled a report on his grave findings regarding the Clay Dwarves and their potential animation through spirit-binding magic. He has tasked me with delivering this urgent dispatch directly to Commander Thraen Dunzchasm, the leader of the Restoration's Hammer, who is currently at his command post in Hammer Rest.
more: Bring Flinthelm's letter to Commander Thraen Dunzchasm

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Theran's Reward

6064633730033451032.title: Corruption Afoot
6064633730033451032.description: Commander Dunzchasm, deeply troubled by Flinthelm's theories on spirit-binding, has asked me to investigate old rumors of screams heard in the deepest, uncharted sections of the Veinbreaker Mines. He fears these sounds may be connected to the animation of the Clay Dwarves and the fate of missing settlers. I must explore the depths of Veinbreaker Mines to search for clues, and report my findings.
more: Search for clues in Veinbreaker Mine

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

6064633736207925495.title: A Curved Killer
6064633736207925495.description: Master Carpenter Elara Shaggybrows has agreed to teach me the basics of carpentry. I need to gather resouces, then fashion an Ironhearth bow at a woodworking bench and show it to her.
more: Craft an Ironhearth Long or Short Bow at a Carpentry Station

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633736214741240.title: A Stitch in Mine
6064633736214741240.description: Master Tailor Roric Stonewool is willing to teach me the fundamentals of tailoring. I need to sew an Emberwake Vestment from it at the Tailoring Station. I should show him when I'm done.
more: Craft an Emberwake Vestment for Master Tailor Stonewool.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633736217690361.title: Master and Mold
6064633736217690361.description: Master Mason Brynja Ironhide will teach me the basics of stonecraft. I will have to find some stone, bring it to a Stonecrafting bench and hew a weapon-mold, then show it to her.
more: Craft a Granite Weapon Mold at a Stoneworking Station

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633736219984122.title: Forging a Start
6064633736219984122.description: Master Smith Grimdrake has offered to teach me the basics of weaponsmithing. I need to find the resources to craft a weapon at the forge, then show it to him.
more: Craft any Ironhearth weapon at a Smithy

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633763982671872.title: Earning Your Tools
6064633763982671872.description: Garrim Hammersong, a craftsman in Hammer Rest, has offered me a deal. If I demonstrate that I am adept at gathering resources from the wilderness nearby, he will give me a doughty Dunzen Ram to ride.
more: Pick up some harvesting tools, then gather a resource near Hammer Rest.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Seahoof Ram

6064633764382375958.title: The Broken Line
6064633764382375958.description: In a matter of heartbeats, I've left Sanctus and the world I knew behind for the promised wonders of Verra. The power of essence surrounds me. The Restoration's Hammer seeks to reclaim the ancient Dunzenkell Mountainhall as the seat of Dunir power. They've established Hammer Rest to the east, but progress has met resistance.Gatewatcher Borin Stonebeard has tasked me with reaching Gritstone Overwatch, a forward post on the road to Hammer Rest. The commander there, Gretta Ironhand, holds the line against corrupted Automata grabber machines, now hostile and relentless. Strange clay dwarves have also been spotted, but their intent remains unclear. I must report to her.
more: Make your way to Commander Ironhand and if possible, help along the way..

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Artisan Storage Reward

6064633764588617733.title: Tools of the Trade
6064633764588617733.description: Commander Dunzchasm has suggested I speak with Garrim Hammersong as he should have some trade related tasks for me. I'm told I can find him east of the Kinforge near the Hammerrest Statue. He also mentioned that Garrim should be providing me with the tools to get me started.
more: Locate Garrim Hammersong in Hammer Rest

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633765093048331.title: An Old Steed for Small Deeds
6064633765093048331.description: Garrim Hammersong has asked that I ride out to the crafting stations in Hammer Rest's Artisan Camp to refine some of the materials I gathered.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633765578407955.title: Up the River
6064633765578407955.description: Carried on the winds from my childhood home on Sanctus, I am flung to Verra's wonders. Essence is thick in the air, and in my heart. While the Dunir return to the mountain's breast, my kin regroup outside on the banks of the mountain watershed, at a place called Bonfire.Grabber machines now menace the mountain interior, their once-helpful forms corrupted and hostile. Silae Nohotu bid me find Malae Kelori. She guards a river post on the way to Bonfire, holding the line against the machines. Their purpose remains unclear. Are they broken, or twisted by some hidden force? Old enemies like the the Ramkin still stir at the edges as well. I must find Malae, and speak with her.
more: Report to Malae Kelori

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Artisan Storage Reward

6064633765616156696.title: Horns of the Enemy
6064633765616156696.description: Malae Kelori has asked me to join arms against attacking Ramkins - marauding ram-headed creatures that raid the Nikuan settlements with increasing frequency. I need to defeat as many of these Ramkins as I can on my way to Bonfire, and take note of any clues I can find to their purpose here, or who they serve. When I arrive in Bonfire, I should tell Runesinger Naho all that I've learned.
more: Fend off the Ramkin

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633765661638687.title: Noble Calling
6064633765661638687.description: I discovered an oddly carven gem, an amalgam of ruby and obsidian, nestled within the mouth of an enchanted fish. This followed the return of several fish figurines that had apparently been stolen by some rather curious ram-headed thieves. Its a strange find, and I'm hoping someone at Bonfire will be able to shed some light on it.
more: Having recovered a rare gem from a ceremonial pool, I now seek someone whose heart sings of runes and rocks.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Stone Runic Ring

6064633765678874658.title: Harvester's Edge
6064633765678874658.description: Hima Luraki, a craftswoman in Bonfire, has offered me a deal.  If I demonstrate that I am adept at gathering resources from the mountainsides nearby, he will give me a doughty Dunzen Ram to ride.
more: Pick up some harvesting tools, and gather a resource near Bonfire.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Seahoof Ram

6064633765693685799.title: Saddle-Up for Settlement
6064633765693685799.description: Hima Luraki needs refined materials for Bonfire. She has offered to trade a sturdy mount if I use the crafting stations near Bonfire to refine the materials I gathered.
more: Process the resources you gathered for Hima Luraki.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633769130066038.title: Guardians of Clay
6064633769130066038.description: Commander Ironhand has tasked me with acquiring a rune-etched plate that only comes from the powerful Clayborn Guardians found deeper in the ruins. Runescribe Flintstone will be waiting for it in Hammer Rest.
more: Destroy a Clayborn Guardian to obtain a go Rune-Etched Plate

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633769464168448.title: The Forgemaster's Legacy
6064633769464168448.description: Commander Thraen Dunzchasm has tasked me with finding a master smith named Bindur Flatfoot in Hammer Rest. Bindur is an expert in ancient forge lore and is particularly interested in the legendary Varnok's Forge. I need to speak with Bindur to understand his theories and his request to investigate the forge.
more: Report to Binder Flatfoot

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633769518301187.title: The Old Smith
6064633769518301187.description:
Bindur Flatfoot seeks a brave soul to venture to the forgotten Varnok's Forge, where the legendary smith Varnok, who sought to bind the elements to his will, hid his unfinished masterwork. Bindur hopes to uncover Varnok's secrets to aid his apprentice, Valen Sparkhammer.?
Travel to the defunct Varnok's Forge, confirm its state, seek Varnok's journal, uncover anything that might explain Varnok's secret, and deliver the findings to Valen Sparkhammer in Vhalgadim.
more: Investigate Varnok's Forge

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Bidur's Old Luggage

6064633769647341578.title: The Heartstone Vault
6064633769647341578.description: Varnok's journal speaks of a hidden vault where he sealed his 'Unfinished Masterwork' - the Heartstone Locket - and its volatile components. He mentioned it was secured by a "riddle of stone and fire" and that understanding the "resonance of Mt. Dun's deep heart" might reveal the way. The "Frozen Assembly" of gems and inlay within the forge seems like the most likely place to start deciphering this riddle.
more: Investigate Varnok's Private Vault

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Varnok's Shroud

6064633769766551568.title: Seek the Source
6064633769766551568.description: Naho has made the determination that the Ramkin are merely servants of a greater power, Minotaur. They're camped at a breach in the mountain walls to the south of Bonfire.
more: Go investigate the camp, and see if you can figure out their purpose there.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633770136240152.title: Reign over the Deluge
6064633770136240152.description:
Runesinger Naho believes the Ramkin to be driven to attack our settlements by cruel Minotaur masters in the Mountain - but these aren't the minotaur of Dwarven legend. These Ironshod are meaner, possessed of cursed powers, and lords of these Ramkin minions.
Naho has told me to bring a gemstone to Sanvi Tharen, the Chieftan of the Nikuan warriors in Bonfire.They will know what to do next.
more: Take the Rune-carved Gemstone to Sanvi Tharen

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Theran's Reward

6064633770178773018.title: Slight of Hoof
6064633770178773018.description: Chieftan Theran has told me that I should follow the waterways into the Mountainhalls at the Nexus Regulator - and from there seek out a lock or mechanism that the Minotaur are employing the Runecarved Gemstones to bypass.
more: Investigate the Nexus Regulator

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Theran's Hat Box

6064633770286514212.title: Course of Force
6064633770286514212.description: Chieftain Sanvi is curious what has her kin Miori's attention along the ancient Dwarven waterways of the Anvils. She has asked me to question Miori about her findings, and see if I can draw any parallels between that and what I've seen myself.
more: Speak with Miori in Bonfire

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633770306764839.title: A Befouling Effluence
6064633770306764839.description: Miori Ashan in Bonfire has been watching the Minotaur near the Thrumchurn Waterwheel in the Anvils and suspects that they, and their Ramkin minions are subject to a curse. They can't prove it, yet.They would like you to travel up the ancient Dwarven waterways of the Anvils toward the great old waterwheel, and seek proof of this, then deliver whatever evidence you can find to their colleague, Leilo, in the settlement of Kal Torhum.
more: Investigate the waterways of the Anvils

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Leilo's Worn Duffel

6064633770392420400.title: A Befouling Effluence
6064633770392420400.description: Miori Ashan in Bonfire has been watching the Minotaur near the Thrumchurn Waterwheel in the Anvils and suspects that they, and their Ramkin minions are subject to a curse. They can't prove it, yet.They would like you to travel up the ancient Dwarven waterways of the Anvils toward the great old waterwheel, and seek proof of this, then deliver whatever evidence you can find to their colleague, Leilo, in the settlement of Kal Torhum.
more: Investigate the waterways of the Anvils

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Varnok's Shroud

6064633770514186294.title: Sweet Gifts of Verra
6064633770514186294.description: Master Farmer Tama Lioren has offered to teach me the tricks of the trade. I need to grow some Blackberries at any Farming Station.After I have grown some Blackberries at the Farming Station, I should present them to Tama for approval.
more: Grow Blackberries at the Farming Station

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633770676912186.title: Warm Boots
6064633770676912186.description: Zanai Kelora will teach me the basics of leatherworking. I need to fashion a pair of Stonechant Treads at the leatherworker's bench, and present them to a Master Leatherworker for review.
more: Craft a pair of Stonechant Treads at a Leatherworking Station

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633770717872190.title: In Good Taste
6064633770717872190.description: Zaelo Kethan has offered to show me the basics of cooking. I need to gather resources, craft a Blackberry Compote at the kitchen, and bring it back to Zaelo for taste-testing.
more: Prepare a Blackberry Compote at a Cooking Station

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633770821091394.title: The Essence of Longevity
6064633770821091394.description: Master Alchemist Uleni Takar has agreed to teach me the basics of alchemy. I will need to find ruby, and to buy some sugar to craft a health salve at an alchemy bench, then present it to her for review.
more: Prepare a Health Salve at an Alchemy Station

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633775283437568.title: The Old Stones
6064633775283437568.description: Runescribe Flinthelm has made a disturbing discovery. He believes the Clay Dwarves may be animated by bound spirits, a form of forbidden magic. The runes on the Gilded Armor suggest powerful binding enchantments. He needs me to go to the Veinbreaker Mines to collect samples of strange ores the Clay Dwarves are extracting, as these might be key components for this profane process.
more: Investigate the activity at the Veinbreaker Mines

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633861101270341.title: Those That Remained
6064633861101270341.description: I found an odd, inscribed ring locked inside an equally strange pillar.  The keys were equally strange - Dunzenkell runes, legible and not like the ones on the Clay Dwarves, yet they were held by the Clay Dwarves. I'm not sure what to make of it, but maybe someone in Hammer Rest can help.
more: Decipher the pillars along Old King's Road.

rewards.name: Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@
Stone Runic Ring

6064633963154374754.title: Shines Like Treasure
6064633963154374754.description: "We be chasing the golden gill and filling our belly with its tasy ilk." - Thollik Underhook
more: Fish Kings Coin from the waters in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963229151333.title: From Snow to Sea
6064633963229151333.description: "My fate flows with the Frostflash, down rivers from snow to sea." - Grimgar the Waveforged
more: Fish Frostflash from the waters in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963274043495.title: Hemlock for the Holidays
6064633963274043495.description: "Every Timberfest my clan would decorate the finest Hemlock with pretzels and steins." - Garrim Hammersong
more: Fell Eastern Hemlock lumber in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963283415144.title: Lurching Larches
6064633963283415144.description: "When the east winds roar, the Western Larches do sway, felling the weak." - Elara Shaggybrows
more: Fell Western Larch lumber in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963409244270.title: The Spawn of Glaciers
6064633963409244270.description: "Roughrime is the spawn of glacier and the magical moonlight. I have seen much of it on my mountain expeditions." - Gretta Ironhand
more: Mine Roughrime from the rocky hills and caverns in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963414945903.title: Tripping Over Granite
6064633963414945903.description: "You can't take a step in the Anvils without tripping over Granite. It's what built the ancient halls." - Commander Thraen Dunzchasm
more: Mine Granite from the rocky hills and caverns in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963441160306.title: Day of Daffodils
6064633963441160306.description: "A bonnet adorned with Daffodils? It's a bit Sanctus! We're in Verra now. Unless this is the Day of Daffodils, I refuse to create the past." - Arch-Tailor Roric Stonewool
more: Reap Daffodils in the foothills and valleys Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633963445223539.title: Scouring for Snowdrop
6064633963445223539.description: "Scour the foothills! We'll need all the Snowdrop we can reap. Its gifts are many as are the days we must endure." - Gretta Ironhand
more: Reap Snowdrops in the foothills and valleys Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633967309684736.title: A Sprig of Willow
6064633967309684736.description: "Always post a sprig of Weeping Willow over the armory, to honor those that fell before us." - Hawkwulin Grimdrake
more: Fell Weeping Willow lumber in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633967312371713.title: Crown of the Anvils
6064633967312371713.description: "Like a crown, the beauty of the Eddledorn is found atop the Anvils." - Commander Thraen Dunzchasm
more: Fell Eddledorn lumber in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633967313944578.title: Taming the Umbraelix
6064633967313944578.description: Fell Umbraelix lumber in the Anvils
more: "It's not like the trees-it's a beast underfoot! But even a beast can be tamed." - Brynja Ironhide

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633967315714051.title: Might of the Korn'brolach
6064633967315714051.description: "It bends and sways, never relenting to the mightiest of winds. The might of the Korn'brolach is unmatched!" - Elara Shaggybrows
more: Fell Korn'brolach Fir lumber in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633967946891272.title: Forge Fish
6064633967946891272.description: "I call them forge fish because they only swim in waters boiling like the pits of Golgora." - Bindur Flatfoot
more: Fish Moltrout from the waters in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache

6064633967971139593.title: Rumble Fish
6064633967971139593.description: "Keep your eyes on the Smoke Loach, if they flee the waters of the ruins, Dun will rumble to ruins." - Runescribe Flinthelm
more: Fish Smoke Loach from the waters in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633967976710154.title: Latchlip Luster
6064633967976710154.description: "The Latchlip is a dangeorus fish, but the luster of its metallic hide is enough to draw ones hook into the coldest waters." - Thollik Underhook
more: Fish Latchlip from the waters in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633968285253656.title: The Burning Heart
6064633968285253656.description: "It's been called the the Burning Heart, a stone that retains the heat from forges long extinguished." - Hawkwulin Grimdrake
more: Mine Tendonite from the rocky hills and caverns in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633968318218265.title: Copper Runs Deep
6064633968318218265.description: "Copper veins run deep within the Anvils, often breaching the surface and hiding within stone." - Bindur Flatfoot
more: Mine Copper from the rocky hills and caverns in the Anvils

rewards.name: Commissioner's Cache
Use: Consolidate a full stack into one @ItemGuid.6064629147780775936.MakeLink@

6064633968320249882.title: Rocky Remedy
6064633968320249882.description: "It has many many uses. Smithies unlock its riddles and alchemists reveal its remedies. Such is Zinc." - Runescribe Flinthelm
more: Mine Zinc from the rocky hills and caverns in the Anvils

Securing the Trade Routes
Secure the local trade route bridges.

I have volunteered for the Kaelar Army's Settler Militia! Captain Eudoxia Avenmoor has informed me of the recent rise in goblin incursions into the farmlands. Having few military resources to pull from, she has instructed all militia members, myself included, to help secure the trade routes by purging the nearby bridges of goblin threats.
Goblins in the Grazelands
Tend to the protection of the Grazeland trade sites.

Captain Avenmoor has ordered Settler Militia members to look into the goblin troubles in the Grazeland, a rural trade community. I should speak with traders of the farms and ranches there and secure their operations for the greater glory of the Kaelar Empire.
Storming the Ruins of Korra'Loch
Purge the goblin presence from the ruins of Korra'Loch.

The goblins have been operating out of the Korr'?Loch ruins in the Grazelands. Captain Avenmoor has requested that every available Settler Militia member reinforce all attempts to purge the ruins of this strategic threat. There can be no peace for the trade community until the goblins have been driven out of the Grazeland.

more: You have encountered a mysterious traveling merchant at night. He speaks in poetry rather than direct speech. After giving him a hideous Vuul'Vodekka, he recited another poem that hints at your next move if you choose to investigate this strange merchant.

108430908085916.title: Mother of Maidens
108430908085916.description: Find something called the Mother of Maidens
more: The tome suggests that I must find something called the Mother of Maidens, possibly a magical necklace.

108430926894749.title: A Champion Most Feared
108430926894749.description: Find a way to free the soul of Edyria.
more: The poem seems to detail the twisted wish of each of the six daughters. Lyndra looked for beauty and was turned into a magnificent flower. Whatever wish is to come, it is most certainly as corrupt and twisted as those before it. You must read on!

108430941640350.title: The Tauroxian Idols
108430941640350.description: Search for the three Tauroxian Idols
more: The Vuul'Vodex tome seems to be instructing me to seek out three idols called the Tauroxian Idols. They are said to be cursed.

108430950094495.title: The Power of Thee
108430950094495.description: Find a way to free the soul of Melayna.
more: The sister Tarys? wish for immortality was delivered and as twisted as before. She has experienced a thousand sunrises for sure as she was transformed into a statue. She was sentenced to immortality within the fields of the Riverlands. It was difficult to get such a work of art to her home with the Antiquitor. Now you must read on about the final sister.

108430956582560.title: The Sunderer of Souls
108430956582560.description: Find a way to free the soul of the Antiquitor.
more: The Curses have been defeated. It was a powerful demon named Vuul'Voxxuss that turned the Antiquitor mad and twisted the wishes of the Sisters of Sephillion. After defeating the demon, the souls of the sisters were freed to depart to the peaceful fields of the afterlife. The Antiquitor was free from his madness and after rewarding those that cured the curses, vanished with a promise to return to Verra.

108447086892665.title: Shady Vendor
