108549895575161.description: Seek and Destroy the local Divine Carnage cult
more: The Antiquitor stated that a cult called the Divine Carnage is looking to slay all variants of the Antiquitor on Verra. He needs you to destroy the local cult.

108600079701631.title: Bubbling Brew
108600079701631.description: Create a spell to weaken the Witch of Sephillon
more: Acquire the components for a Cloud of Wicked Weakness to defeat the Witch of Sephillion.

108765021623932.title: Sunk Cost
108765021623932.description: Secure the waterways across the Riverlands
more: Tricia Farrier needs help keeping fisherfolk and travelers safe from unquiet dead appearing from unnatural waters all across the Riverlands. I might be able to help by keeping enough of these monsters at bay.

108765028832893.title: Accursed Legacy
108765028832893.description: Search for clues to uncover the nature of the curse plaguing the Wreckage of Carphin
more: Orren suspects the Seeping Scarlet is a consequence of intentionally corrupted essence at Carphin during the Harbinger Apocalypse. He could use my help cutting through the fog of history.

108765147584126.title: Unquiet Dead
108765147584126.description: Sweep through the Wreckage of Carphin to ensure worker team safety
more: Tricia's got a mind to send worker crews to tear down the doors to the mage tower and expose the source within, but the ruins are too dangerous as is. She's farming out the task of making it safe again to mercenaries and adventurers.

108765547484799.title: Seeping Scarlet
108765547484799.description: Investigate the Seeping Scarlet and determine its dangers
more: Orren LeMonte, a Scholar's Academy researcher, seeks answers to the questions of the origins and dangers of the strange, red mist covering the Wreckage of Carphin.

108787933271715.title: Spirit of the Arena
108787933271715.description: Raise the Spirit of the Mangler
more: You have proven yourself a champion after defeating the spirit of the Mangler.

109065035011711.title: The Homestead Unharrowed
109065035011711.description: Find a way to defeat The Nightcreeper
more: The truth behind the killings at Bolen Stead is worse than what anyone might have imagined. Though we've no idea what to expect, Captain Rodrigar admitted that all reports corroborate one narrative: there is a dark and ancient creature haunting the woods near there, and the boy that lived will know no justice until that monster is slain.

109122314458749.title: Welcome to Verra!
more: Find a representative of the Cleric class in Lionhold.

109122314589822.title: Welcome to Verra!
more: Find a representative of the Ranger class in Lionhold.

109127204820629.title: Report for Service
more: Make your way to Kina Wendsward in the Ruins of Aela

109127208818326.title: Festering Scum
109127208818326.description: Help Adil Arwai treat the wounded in the Ruins of Aela
more: Goblin bites fester something fierce. Help Adil treat the wounded.

109127252727451.title: Lay of the Land
more: Report to Halson of the Striders Vigilant in the Ruins of Aela.

109308550076046.title: Mission of Mercy
109308550076046.description: Help Adil Arwai treat the wounded in the Ruins of Aela
more: Adil Arwai is somewhere in the Ruins of Aela, find him and ask how you might help.

109343105046143.title: Secrets in the soot
109343105046143.description: Investigate the goblins' works in the ruin.
more: Goblins have left makeshift shrines and graffiti all around their nests, investigate the inspiration for these.

109347846641286.title: Shaman's Rede
109347846641286.description: Discover the Goblins' goal in the ruins.
more: Follow the clues into the submerged depths of the Aelan Ruins seeking the goblin Shaman.

109354521286264.title: Block Buster
more: Kina needs support defending the ruins from encroaching goblins and highwaymen.

109354523973241.title: Safe Harborage
109354523973241.description: Drive the Goblins from the ruins
more: Kina needs you to Investigate and Destroy Goblin Nests, then report what you've found.

109354731198082.title: Dank Revelations
109354731198082.description: Venture into the depths of the ruins of Aela and investigate the connection between the Goblins and the Highwaymen.
more: Kina Wendsward has asked that you enter the flooded depths of the Ruins of Aela and investigate the goblins and the undead.

109359883441785.title: Light the Way
109359883441785.description: Maintain the lanterns in the ruins.
more: The rangers of the Striders keep the lanterns along the paths lit. Do your part to light any that have burnt out.

109359884686970.title: Stories from Shrines
109359884686970.description: Report goblin activities to Adil the Fighter in the Ruins.
more: Investigate goblin activities in the Ruins and report that information to Adil.

109359984236157.title: last thing
more: last thing

109421235820157.title: Welcome to Verra!
more: Someone around here will give you a job, probably.

6064628657293099018.title: Tale of Tallfoot
6064628657293099018.description: Investigate the old book, 'The Priestess and the Piper'
more: You have acquired an ancient book with a children's fable entitled, 'The Priestess and the Piper.' It looks weathered, but possibly of some value. You should look into this! Perhaps there are scholars who specialize in such rarities.

6064628657298014219.title: Gone Un'Morrow
6064628657298014219.description: Investigate the missing girl Alisha Un'Morrow
more: A missing persons notice for a Kaelar girl, Alisha Un'Morrow, has been posted by the local Constable. The reward for their return is quite exorbitant and a good deed done is a reputable deed.

6064628657302405132.title: Bone To Pick
more: You have discovered a necklace of finger bones. Such a grotesque item must hide a secret that you are driven to investigate.

6064628657305944077.title: Beggar and Locks
6064628657305944077.description: Investigate the complex lock of the strongbox
more: You have encountered an enigmatic beggar who, in exchange for a few glint, has passed onto you a seemingly worthless box. However, the box is bound by a complex lock that the beggar challenged you to unlock.

6064628657309155342.title: The Whistling Key
6064628657309155342.description: Find the chest the whistling key belongs to
more: You have a peculiar key with a whistle given to you by an even more peculiar beggar. Discover the chest the key will open.

6064628657315512335.title: Host, Hoist, Heist
6064628657315512335.description: Find a way to locate and steal Baron Kelnair's brewery coffer.
more: The Piper is hosting a Steinhoist in order to get the wealthy drunk and keep them busy as he has he and his accomplices heist their valuables. You're target is the concealed coffer of Baron Kelnair of Northwind Brewery.

6064628657319444496.title: The Great Bloomfest Hunt
6064628657319444496.description: Hit the Riverlands and join the hunt for flowers. Earn your Bloomfest Crown!
more: The Hunt Is On! The annual Great Bloomfest Hunt has begun. You have until the end of Bloomfest to collect the flowers needed to complete your Bloomfest Bouquet. Do so and you can earn the highly desired Bloomfest Crown!

6064628657326063633.title: The Legion of the Rose
6064628657326063633.description: Complete the four feats of the Rose to join the Legion of the Rose
more: Take on the Challenge of the Rose and become a member of the Legion of the Rose, a private honorary knighthood. Simply recreate the greatest feats of the four greatest knights of the defunct Order of the Rose

6064628657336942610.title: Advanced ED&D
6064628657336942610.description: Find the young adults that were playing ED&D near the citadel
more: Young adults playing a game called Exalted Denizens and Duzakh have gone missing in the midst of their game. Their game of ED&D led them out to the wilds. Some say they were eaten by a bog witch. You must find them!

6064628657341464595.title: Key to the Citadel
6064628657341464595.description: Get a citadel strongbox key from a mercenary caravan
more: The Piper sees this as a good time to raid the vaults of the Citadel, but he is going to need a Skeleton Key that can be used on all the Sons of Fortune Strongboxes. Mercenary Caravans might just have what you need.

6064628657344086036.title: The Battle of Bloom
6064628657344086036.description: Discover the lost history of the Battle of Bloom.
more: With the Seals of Sephillion safely intact, the Piper needs me to recover the lore of the secret crusade, the Battle of Bloom, that led to the imprisonment of the evil priestess, Deliath. Such a veiled history is surely known by someone and it can help use defeat the demoness if we must.

6064628657350115349.title: Carnage Unleashed!
6064628657350115349.description: Venture deep into the citadel to stop Deliath, the Priestess of Carnage.
more: Hell is unleashed! The Priestess has risen if players have so chosen this path. She has used her Shedim powers to corrupt the Steel Bloom Haunts into Tortured Haunts (Red Aura).

6064628657352015894.title: Thorn of the Rose
6064628657352015894.description: Reset the phylacteries and destroy the ancient guardian, the Thorn of the Rose
more: Hell is unleashed! Employing the 4 Phylacteries the Vault of the Priestess is opened. However, instead of awakening the slumbering Priestess, the phylacteries are locked, leaving the vault open and free to plunder. Unfortunately, now the final Immortal Knight of Bloom must be defeated, The Thorn of the Rose!

6064628781727481856.title: Courier's Choice
6064628781727481856.description: Advise the steward on who should wield the reforged Muckbeard's Blade.
more: Goblins have been drawn out of their caves and into the open field. The Kaelar forces are ready to demonstrate the effects of Muckbeard's Curse. The only question that remains is who should take the cursed blade to the center of conflict. As a neutral actor, the steward seeks your advice on the matter.

6064628816588439559.title: Pilgrim's Rest
6064628816588439559.description: Help Tarief perform the dedication ritual to complete his Monument to the Fallen.
more: The monument to the fallen Vaelune is nearly complete. Help Tarief to perform a final dedication ceremony.

6064629024328777729.title: A Grim Undertaking
6064629024328777729.description: Purge undead at Gravehill to secure the resettling of Bolen Stead
more: Though the Bolen family is dead, their farmstead is relatively well-intact. Captain Rodrigar believes it can be resettled once the creatures responsible for the death of its previous inhabitants have been culled.

6064629024338214914.title: Savagery Met with Savagery
6064629024338214914.description: Mete out justice on behalf of the Bolen family
more: The Captain believes goblins are to blame for the massacre at Bolen Stead. He's issued a writ of reward for anyone willing to bring to their homes the violence they brought to Bolen Stead.

6064629163993006083.title: Recovering Reagents
6064629163993006083.description: Help the Pilgrim Dory Sheller create a new offering
more: A pilgrim named Dory Sheller needs my help to rebuild an offering he planned to make at a local shrine after some bandits attacked his caravan.

6064629164011945988.title: Sanctify the Shrine
more: Dory Sheller meant to make an offering at the peak of the Sentinel before a bandit ambush left him too hurt to make the trip. I offered to maintain the shrine for him.

6064629164020006917.title: Recite the Words
6064629164020006917.description: Perform the ritual to the best of your ability
more: Dory Sheller managed to repackage his offering, but is frustrated with how slow he's been to heal. I agreed to bring the offering to the shrine on his behalf.

6064629268470431837.title: The Raven Plague
6064629268470431837.description: If the Bowen Family is infected, eradicate them and anyone they have come in contact with.
more: The Prime Healer, Enid, of the Kaelar Army has asked you to check on her good friends the Bowen Farm. They may be infected with the Raven Plague and must be eradicated as well as any Blood Ravens. There must be no mercy if the Riverlands is to survive!

6064629285126144069.title: The Plague Potion
6064629285126144069.description: Help find an antidote for the Raven Plague.
more: An alchemist, Lynette Xander, is investigating a possible antidote for the deadly Blood Raven Plague that has broken out in the Riverlands. This will require looking to ancient history, the only other time the plague was seen and stopped by a band of soldiers called the Puritans.

6064629286571606026.title: Bearberry Jam
6064629286571606026.description: Help Lily gather berries for tarts.
more: Find and gather some Bearberries for Lily

6064629291282464836.title: The Midnight Carnival
6064629291282464836.description: Investigate the Midnight Carnival in Gravepeak
more: Ignoring the Blood Raven Plague, the mysterious Midnight Carnival has moved into the Riverlands. They have propped up shop in the Gravepeak foothills. This is most unusual and demands further investigation.

6064629296769400870.title: Ritual of Ravens
6064629296769400870.description: Lynette has vanished and must be found before some evil king returns.
more: Lynette Xander has gone missing and the only clue is her journal and its last entry speaking of the return of an evil king. She must be found if there is any chance to stop this deadly resurrection and the Blood Raven Plague.

6064629326136606753.title: Flight From the Woods
more: Help Tomas by Defeating Ghosts and Bears in Oakenbane Keep

6064629326143750178.title: Titans' Shadow
6064629326143750178.description: Explore the Remnants of Oakenbane Keep
more: Conrad has asked that you explore the Remnants of Oakenbane Keep and tell him what you find.

6064629364080836612.title: Parting the Seas
6064629364080836612.description: Scour the land for the components of Intra-Sphere
more: Olek Bellsong created a mechanical orb called the Restructuring Dimensional Intra-Sphere. This unique device was a arcane machine that delivered him to a time of the ?great undying? where it lost vital components. Find the missing components and reset them where they belong.

6064629364122124497.title: Descent to the Backwaters
6064629364122124497.description: Find your way to the lowlands to undercut the apothecary.
more: At the apothecary, a hooded patron offers to undercut the merchant alchemist. After the shop was robbed during the last siege, the merchant has gouged prices for faulty contraband, and needs to replenish his salves on the cheap. The sordid patron thinks he can save a pretty penny by collecting the supplies himself, since it's worth the same if the fish oil is collected from the fisherman he knows in the Skip. There's bound to be trouble along the road, but it might worth the hassle to try to fetch the same deal.

6064629370192920628.title: An Ancient Visitor
6064629370192920628.description: Locate the Clockwork Codex Key to discover why the tower is back.
more: The Tower Arcana appeared again and it seems to have brought with it, demon dogs! Where has it been and why is it here? The codex key is missing and must be recovered to ask the Clockwork Codex.

6064629371090174043.title: Brotherhood of the Missing Cloak
6064629371090174043.description: Find out what the Stonecutters owe to the League of Tradesfolk.
more: The priory permits entrance once they recognize the tabard lifted from the band of thieves. There's a missing abbot who hasn't returned since he'd been sent to collect some thistles, and his friend thinks it may be wise to dispel the ravens while you're on route. Someone else may know which knolls he would visit or whether he may have been followed.

6064629381204082688.title: Betrayal Of Future Past
6064629381204082688.description: Seek and destroy Malgus, the Djinn Demon.
more: The Tower Arcana has reappeared, but this time with a stowaway! An extremely powerful Djinn named Malgus has escaped imprisonment in the far future and now plots the eradication of all Verrans. Fortunately, he used most of his power to energize the Intra-Sphere so it could finally go backwards in time and space. This means there is a window of opportunity to track him down and destroy him before he regains power.

6064629382416760994.title: Olek's Final Words
6064629382416760994.description: Find Olek's missing tomes before the tower vanishes.

6064629386836705280.title: An Old Friend
6064629386836705280.description: Find out why the Tower Arcana has returned.
more: The Tower Arcana has reappeared! The Academy of Arcane Scholars of Verra have discovered it and hope to claim it for research. Due to the perplexing applied magic used to craft the Intra-Sphere, the scholars find it impossible to move. But move it shall, as always. Perhaps you can find some reason for its return before it removes itself from this reality yet again.

6064629410507981303.title: The Heritage of Households
6064629410507981303.description: Avenge the dead abbot and correct the Heritage of Households
more: When he died, the Abbot of the Pillars thought he might have recognized the robes on his assailant. The description matches one of the Lowlands Abbey, sacrilegious clerics who keep ferocious wolves among them as companions. He may have been followed by one of the Stonecutters after he had refused to modify the lettering on one of the branches of the Heritage of Households. He urges you to find out more from the Letterist and interrogate the Lowlanders about the lost nephew of the Radiant, Sir Renslee. If the cleric speaks the truth, this information might be valuable to some high ranking officials.

6064629444032528384.title: Trail of Toil
6064629444032528384.description: Investigate the Terrorgore Minotaur camps in the Riverlands
more: Ra'aqir has noticed that the Terrorgore Minotaurs of the Riverlands are up to something...

6064629444034887681.title: Turning of the Year
6064629444034887681.description: Investigate the movements of the Minotaur tribe in the Riverlands
more: Ra'aqir is worried that the minotaurs in the Riverlands are planning something nefarious, he'd like you to investigate their camps.

6064629444041703426.title: Bullish on Magic
more: Disrupt the minotaur cultists' ritual

6064629444304764932.title: Clear the Keep
6064629444304764932.description: Clear out the goblins from the Crossroads Keep.
more: The Goblin Munglers have claimed the vacant Crossroads Keep and associated property. Clear the area of this threat and discover what happened here.

6064629449123692544.title: Search and Rescue
6064629449123692544.description: The owner of Crossroads Keep must be rescued.
more: Budge MacKraggin, the owner of Crossroads Keep, led a band of mercenaries to hunt goblin Munglers. They never returned and the Munglers took over the area. Search for Budge and his guards and free them so they can retake the keep and secure it for business.

6064629449786523727.title: Cloaks and Caravans
6064629449786523727.description: Help Budge form a business alliance with a faction.
more: Budge MacKraggin may have retaken the keep with your help, but he will need greater aid in keeping it. He has heard the Court of Cloaks and the Greyshore Transporters are interested in helping secure his trading post. You must locate the contacts and decide which faction is best for Budge and the roads of the central Riverlands.

6064629461545189477.title: Master of Mungle
6064629461545189477.description: Hunt down the mysterious Mungle, the master of Munglers.
more: With an alliance sealed you can now focus on removing the head of the proverbial snake, kill the  leader of the Munglers, Chief Mungle.

6064629501545349375.title: The Demon's Pitchfork
more: You've been contracted by a shady character just outside of Lionhold. He offered you a simple task, find and execute a thief hiding amongst the Farmhands at Briarmoor Farms. Farmer Lyle is a Court of Cloaks contact there, find him to report the completion of your task.

6064629501555900672.title: A Quicksilver Toast
6064629501555900672.description: Find out more about why the Cloaks turned against you.
more: The Court of Cloaks are going out of their way to erase all traces that this unnamed serf with an oakleaf medallion had ever lived. Now that the syndicate have shown their intentions and the guards have been misled, there isn't a single trustworthy accomplice to hide the evidence of involvement. Jayna the Cinder Maid might be the last resort for outcasts running to shelter from the authorities, and the lunatic might even have a few tricks up her sleeve to hoodwink any remaining pursuers.

6064629501560684801.title: Blind Maven Fandango
6064629501560684801.description: Chase down Boyle's ties to the Court of Cloaks.
more: While the hippodrome may the next stop for the traveling troupe, the Blind Mavens may be familiar guests of the Court of Cloaks who reside in the riverlands. In the gleeful atmosphere of the ongoing carnival, the somber conversationalist is hard to find for information on death of Nil Feiann and other devious plans underfoot. Sleuthing some bigger conspiracies will help to keep guards off Boyle's trail, and guard against any further attempts from the syndicate.

6064629576576270339.title: Sourcing Herbs
6064629576576270339.description: Help Botanist Lorne secure a supply of herbs.

6064629576583086084.title: Sourcing Meat
6064629576583086084.description: Help Botanist Lorne secure a supply of meat.

6064629576592850949.title: Running Trials
6064629576592850949.description: Find a way to test the effects of corruption.

6064629664374390787.title: Mapping the Coil
6064629664374390787.description: Search Carphin for a Mapping Crystal
more: A treasure hunter named Sergia Fletcher seeks to assemble a Coil Reflector so she can speak to a historical figure about gaining entry to the Tower of Carphin. One of these parts is a mapping crystal. I should look somewhere in Carphin that important people lived.

6064629664379437061.title: To Materialize the Immaterial
more: A treasure hunter named Sergia Fletcher seeks to assemble a Coil Reflector so she can speak to a historical figure about gaining entry to the Tower of Carphin. Without a liminal condenser to amplify the paltry essence left in a mapping crystal, she won't be able to finish the device. I should look for one in Oakenbane Keep.

6064629664384942086.title: The Forgotten Lens
more: Sergia seeks a rare piece of glass called a Cinderfired Lens. He believes they were used in ancient Aelan burial rituals, and that one might be found in Gravepeak.

6064629664386580487.title: Unliving History
more: Sergia wants me to return to Carphin and bring the coil projector to the roof of the admin building. I should follow the created projections and ask the coil fragments for information on how to enter Carphin Tower.

6064629823749750784.title: Mushroom Hunting
more: Aunt Flammelina has asked that you bring her a collection of spores from the Aberrant Mycellions in the Riverlands.

6064629824349732898.title: Ill Vapours
6064629824349732898.description: Burn Aunt Flammelina's Sporesmoke Incense at each indicated spot.
more: Auntie has asked that you burn her special incense at each of four indicated places in the Riverlands.

6064629824368803879.title: Miles of Mycellion
6064629824368803879.description: Clear the Riverlands of Mycellion outbreaks
more: Fight Mycellion in the Riverlands

6064629824411992106.title: In the Wind
more: Aunt Flammulina has asked that you return to any of the sites you previously visited and smash the Sporulators there.

6064629851156447233.title: The Ruins of Thanalas
6064629851156447233.description: Infiltrate the ruins and unlock the ancient Pyrian chest.
more: The Highwaymen leader, Orrik Blackwood, has hired me and a burglar named Splint to infiltrate the ruins he once called refuge. A band of minotaurs has seized control and now the bandit king hopes to drive them out by unleashing an ancient curse upon them. All I have to do is survive into the bowels of the ruins and unlock the ancient Pyrian chest that contains the madness!

6064629936977477708.title: The Sephillion Seals
6064629936977477708.description: Discover the origins of the Sephillion Seals.
more: The Sephillion Crystal is one of five and was crafted to arcanely lock the entrance to the dungeons of the Citadel of Steel Bloom. If we are to reveal the mystery below and how its related to the pillar of souls that rises skyward, we must first reveal the origins of the Sephillion Seals.

6064629936984490061.title: A Window of Opportunity
6064629936984490061.description: Help the Piper collect the plunder from the Mercenary Coffers.
more: The Piper doesn't care about ancient evils. With the appearance of haunts in the citadel, the mercenaries are in a frenzy. Such chaos provides a window of opportunity! He wants to collect the plunder of the Sons of Fortune and cut and run! He has promised a generous portion of the treasures that can be hauled from Citadel of Steel Bloom to anyone that aids in the heist. It may not be the honorable thing to do, but it is quite promising.

6064630049227472902.title: Locate the Lost
6064630049227472902.description: Locate Kev and his squad in Sephillion
more: Kev and his squad have gone missing! Find them in the Ruins of Sephillion.

6064630049349238791.title: Best Laid Plans
6064630049349238791.description: Help Kev to locate his missing crew
more: Kev arrived at Sephillion with a gang of 4 others, now they're missing!

6064630049355530248.title: Stonefaced in the Moment
6064630049355530248.description: Inform Kev that Seljuk is turned to stone!
more: Seljuk has been turned to stone! Tell Kev that you've found him, and what state he's in.

6064630049357692937.title: Clear as A Memory
6064630049357692937.description: Find and deliver Memory Crystals for Tenarith
more: Tenarith needs Memory Crystals from Crystalline Servants to help her open the vault.

6064630049482211347.title: Paper Trails
more: Gather important papers in Sephillion and return them to Kev

6064630049484963860.title: Shining Revelation
more: Investigate the Crystal Admin for Kev

6064630049566556186.title: Deeper Designs
6064630049566556186.description: Gather Geometric Apparatus from Crystalline Guardians
more: Destroy Crystalline Guardians to harvest Geometric Apparatus

6064630049569046555.title: Imposing Figures
more: Destroy the Idols preventing Tenarith from casting her magics.

6064630049571143708.title: These Stones Speak To Me
6064630049571143708.description: Find and return stones to Kolphi
more: Kolphi has a way of reading these memory stones.

6064630049573175325.title: In Fast Fashion
more: Defeat Crystal Monsters to protect Joon and Kolphi

6064630050340864038.title: Crystalline Conscription
6064630050340864038.description: Deliver Sephillion Crystals to the Crystalline Apparatus
more: Gather Crystals of Sephillion and return them to the Crystalline Apparatus for Kev

6064630050342371367.title: Greater Fortune
6064630050342371367.description: Steal artwork from Sephillion for your own gains
more: Kolphi and Joon suggest that you take some time to gather a reward for yourself, Salvaged Sephillion Artworks

6064630050344468520.title: The Watcher Waiting
more: Free the Watcher within Sephillion

6064630050345779241.title: It'd be nice to save Seljuk
more: Seljuk has been turned to stone! Can something be done to help him?

6064630050347221034.title: Hearts in Stone
6064630050347221034.description: Find Sephillion Crystal Shards for Tenarith
more: Tenarith can't abide the idea that so many souls are "trapped" inside the Sephillion Stones. She wants to smash as many as she is able.

6064630100280410119.title: Squatter's Rights
6064630100280410119.description: Secure the land around the Estate for Dinah's people.
more: I found a small community of farmers looking for a way to purify and work the land around the Daragal Estate. Their leader, a man named Dinah, asked for help finding the source of the poison that so heartily resists his efforts to cleanse them. He's seen the goblins in the fields wielding some disgusting, primitive, aspergillum that he suspects are to blame.

6064630163138347009.title: The Lonely Shrine
6064630163138347009.description: I must scour the lonely shrine for its origin.
more: I happened upon a lonely and forgotten shrine. Amidst the ancient grounds I encountered a mysterious entity called the Cryptmonger. This peculiar being has hinted that there is a great reward for those who ca reveal the tale behind the lonely shrine.

6064630174032527470.title: The Horns of the Bull
6064630174032527470.description: Recover the bones of the betrayers, the Horns of the Bull.
more: The Lonely Shrine is an ash pyre of a legendary hero called the Vultauro the Bull. With his marauding horde, the Horns of the Bull, his battle prowess was revered by allies and feared by foes. If not for the ultimate betrayal and desertion of his troops, he would have commanded an unstoppable legion. Now, the only thing that will appease his spirits' unrest is the return and burning of the bones of the marauders and the his once loyal warlords that led them.

6064630196780073025.title: Containing the Rage
6064630196780073025.description: Capture the arcane force of the Bull with the Oubliette Orb.
more: Vultauro the Bull and his horde have risen as rage filled revenants. The Cryptmonger has instructed me to acquire an unusual orb to capture the infernal force of the Bull. This action will require destroying the risen rage of Vultauro, but to do that I will have to crush his horde first. Once the rage is contained, The Bull will be free from torment, so the Cryptmonger states.

6064630315624628229.title: Securing the Trade Routes
more: I have been recruited to aid the local Kaelar settlement. Recent bandit activities along the life giving trade routes have left the local economy in disarray. Bandits frequently seize control of strategic points of the trade routes, choking the supply lines to and from Lionhold. The army is too busy battling goblins so its up to the people to arm themselves and secure the trade routes.

6064630315633934342.title: Trouble In Briarmoor
6064630315633934342.description: Tend to the protection of the Briarmoor trade community.
more: I am to report to Sergeant Orrik Blackwood stationed at Briarmoor Farms. He has been appointed their local Watchman, a resident enforcer of Kaelar laws. However, the few guards under his command have either perished are gone missing. He needs assistance in ridding the Briarmoor of its bandit threat.

6064630315651301383.title: The Mists of Korra'Loch
6064630315651301383.description: Investigate the appearance of the toxic mist in the ruins of Korra'Loch.
more: Orrik Blackwood has asked me to investigate the reports of a toxic waste enveloping the ruins of Korra'Loch, an ancient Aelan garrison. Settlers have reported its expanding borders and humanoids lurking in the thick mist. I must find the origin and extinguish the mists of Korra'Loch.

6064630316225527816.title: Be it Dead or Alive!
6064630316225527816.description: Kill or capture the Kaelar Empire deserters.
more: Captain Avenmoor has officially formed the Settler Militia, a civilian guard that acts as an aggressive military unit wherever and whenever the Kaelar Army cannot. The first call to action is to round up the known bandit conspirators, be it dead or alive!

6064630316235620361.title: The Fields of Fire
6064630316235620361.description: Investigate and put an end to the torching of the Briarmoor crops.
more: The crops in the Briarmoors have been catching fire, leaving the settlers and guards without vital resources. Lieutenant Avenmoor wants available settle militia to investigate and end this problem. I will seek out the origin and put an end to the fields of fire.

6064630316240207882.title: Feed an Army Starve a Settler
6064630316240207882.description: Tag exports as property of the Kaelar Army.
more: The Kaelar Army has ordered that all Briarmoor resources be delivered to Lionhold where it will then be distributed to the military with the remainder going to exports and settlers. Local settlers are not happy with this order, but will comply or face imprisonment. I will scour the Briarmoors for the goods and tag them the property of the Kaelar Army.

6064630316245450763.title: In the Shadows of Nika'Brae
6064630316245450763.description: Raid the Ruins of Nika'Brae and eliminate all bandits.
more: The newly organized and formidable bandits, the Forsaken Blades, are reported to be based in the ruins of the ancient keep, Nika'Brae. The Settler Militia has been ordered to test the strength of the bandits by performing a raid upon the ruins. I have been told to scour the shadows of Nika'Brae for any clue as to who organized the bandits and what they are plotting.

6064630316365971468.title: The Unseen Eye
more: I can help free the Eye of Ozu from the Star of Ozu.

6064630316372721677.title: The Blinding Lights of Ozu
6064630316372721677.description: Destroy the Star of Ozu and stop Uulorian the Lost.
more: According to clues discovered at Nika'Brae, a mad mage named Uulorian the Lost is preparing a destructive spell of immense magnitude. It is said he will perform the deadly ritual at the mysterious Crystal Lake. I must destroy the Star of Ozu before he unleashes the the Blinding Lights of Ozu.

6064630367024513042.title: Ravens' Field
6064630367024513042.description: Drive away the Ravens in Farmer Lyle's field.
more: Farmer Lyle at Briarmoor Farms would like you to drive away the Ravens ravaging his crops.

6064630367669911640.title: The Signals Must Fall
6064630367669911640.description: Destroy the Forsaken Blades signals posted in their bunkers.
more: Sergeant Orrik Blackwood needs help severing the signal posts of the Forsaken Blades. This act will sever their communication and provide a bit more time to plan a counter attack or even gain the initiative.

6064630401871451841.title: Carlin's Calling
6064630401871451841.description: Find Carlin, the errant thief, hiding out amongst the Travelling Troupe.
more: Eliza has informed you that her ex-boyfriend Carlin has run away with an acting troupe. Find him, and see if he will reveal the location of his loot.

6064630401897469637.title: Convince the Court
6064630401897469637.description: PAy off the Court of Cloaks with Carlin's Loot
more: Carlin has told you where he stashed the remains of the loot he stole from teh Court of Cloaks, find it, and return it to Gershwin, your Court of Cloaks contact.

6064630431767199746.title: Half the Battle
more: The settlers on Verra have known constant struggle with the Goblins that overran ancestral Kaelar lands, and yet we know nothing about their capabilities. Now that they're throwing themselves at Samia's Hope's paltry defenses, Amir Osmun needs help assessing the scope of the threat.

6064630432191938576.title: Goblin Hierarchy
6064630432191938576.description: Determine the name of Muckmaw General
more: I managed to intercept some goblin communication written in a warped form of the common tongue, which names a few of their kind that might be responsible for organizing the others. If I can find a few more notes on their bodies, I might be able to determine the name and locaiton of their leader.

6064630433914880017.title: Lost Souls
6064630433914880017.description: Discover the fate of the 12th Expiditionary Spears
more: Ahven Briarmoor at Briarmoor Farms worries over her fiance, a man by the name of Leodras who led a squad of spearmen charged with the defense of Briarmoor. They organized without orders to scout safe routes to bring food to Lionhold, but haven't been seen for days. Ahven fears the worst.

6064630435939811381.title: Gribbok the Naked
more: Captain Avenmoor's compiled enough reports now that she suspects that a goblin that goes by the name "Gribbok the Naked" organizes the raids against Lionhold and Briarmoor Farms. I'll need to figure out a way to draw him out and kill him.

6064630474852990976.title: The Highwaymen Hills or Bust
6064630474852990976.description: Join the Crystal Boom as a proper miner.
more: A large Crystal Boom has erupted in the Riverlands. Thanacite, a rare crystal, has been discovered in the Highwaymen Hills. Unfortunately the hills are overrun with not just prospectors, but the Forsaken Blades as well. Before I can even hope to claim a shard of glory, I need to gain approval to mine in the Kaelar Territory for this rare mineral, Thalacite.

6064630479853322242.title: Catapult Construction
6064630479853322242.description: Help Leodras secure supplies for his catapults.
more: The goblins holed up in the Remnant of Oakenbane erected barricades blocking entrance into the main fortress. Sergeant Leodras has a plan to knock them down, but he needs a supply of raw resources to get started.

6064630479858237445.title: Scouting Mission
6064630479858237445.description: Help Sergeant Leodras concoct a plan to oust the Goblins in Oakenbane.
more: Sergeat Leodras Lionbrannd is looking for anyone willing to help scout the Goblins entrenched in the Remnant of Oakenbane. If I can help him gather intel, he'll reward me.

6064630479862497288.title: Locked and Loaded
6064630479862497288.description: Help Leodras's artillery battery smash the barricades stopping access to the Remnant of Oakenbane Keep

6064630479866101771.title: Make Them Bleed
6064630479866101771.description: Kill goblins and take their ears as bounty.
more: Leodras is paying a bounty for Goblin Ears if I'm interested in a cash reward.

6064630486479929380.title: On Sacred Ground
6064630486479929380.description: Collect minotaur artifacts in the Highwaymen Hills.
more: A scholar of minotaur history desires a number of minotaur artifacts found within the Highwaymen Hills. With a crystal boom going on, many of the artifacts have been uncovered and ignored or even stolen by prospectors. If I collect these minotaur artifacts and return them to her, she will reward me with treasure and knowledge of the forgotten history revealed on these sacred grounds.

6064630525470048301.title: The Great Unifier
6064630525470048301.description: Recover the history of Jarrak Lyneth, the Great Unifier.
more: The history of Jarrak Lyneth is somewhat muddled and could hold the answer to the recent appearance of a minotaur horde near the Aela Ruins. I shall help Akhunda Wadoo of the Academy of Scholars, recover the lost history of the Great Unifier.

6064630531090546716.title: The Horn of Doom
6064630531090546716.description: Retrieve the Horn of Doom from Highwaymen Hills.
more: The Minotaur horde has invaded the Highwaymen Hills and seized the headquarters of the Forsaken Blades, the ruins of Thanalus. They seek to acquire the arcane artifact, the Horn of Doom and use its power for nefarious purposes. I will help the Kaelar Empire by infiltrating the ruins and seizing the horn before the minotaur Firesky Horde can find it.

6064630536694398995.title: We Rise after Felling
more: The master woodcutter bid me prove my burgeoning skills in lumberjacking before he'll grant me the rank of journeyman. Though they may be rough, I'll need to show him workable lumber cut from oak timber taken by my own axe.

6064630553112084482.title: Strike the Earth!
more: The quarry foreman is in desperate need of workers willing to break rocks and ore to satisfy the absurd demand for workable stone and metal in Lionhold. He had no tools to spare, but gave me some materials and bade me prove my desire to learn by assembling a pickaxe of my own.

6064630553163792390.title: A Feast of Flowers
6064630553163792390.description: Craft a Crude Sickle and show it to the Master Forager
more: Though farmers toil the rich soils here on Verra, crops still need more time to come up. Botanists, herbalists and foragers alike have come together to fill the gaps in plant material for food and medicine. The surge in demand and scarcity of labor has led to many offering to exchange knowledge for labor, provided prospectives bring their own tools.

6064630614151528826.title: Sever the Head
6064630614151528826.description: Search Oakenbane for the Goblin Leadership and dismantle it
more: The time of the final assault on the Goblins in Oakenbane has arrived. I'm to join the forces assaulting the fortress, push past the front lines and into the fort itself. Once there, I should see high value targets to slay.

6064630614368911380.title: A Decisive Victory
6064630614368911380.description: Inform Eudoxia Avenmoor of your successful campaign against the goblins of Oakenbane
more: WIth the goblin leadership in shambles, they're likely to disperse for good. Captain Eudoxia Avenmoor will be grateful for all I've done to help.

6064630797373079565.title: When In Bloom
6064630797373079565.description: Place an offering at the foot of the lonely gravestone.
more: I have discovered a lone grave on a tiny isle at the Lonely Grave Pond outside of Korra'Loch. The stone hints that a Moonlight Bloom floral offering can be placed at the grave, 'When in bloom.' Such a noble deed could grant a humble reward.

6064631522953662826.title: Field and Stream
6064631522953662826.description: Locate and Investigate the nearby minotaur camp.
more: Visit the old minotaur camp in the North-Eastern Riverlands and investigate the remains.

6064632019840663555.title: Raid and Relic
6064632019840663555.description: Raid the Citadel of Steel Bloom
more: We must raid the Citadel of Steel Bloom and retrieve the Orb of Ultimate Essence. An evil cult hopes to tap into its powers and only we and the spirit of the Lady of the Rose are all that stand in their way of Golgora unleashed.
Spectral Knight
The noble aura of a spectral knight penetrates the ancient field of battle.

6064632019860586500.title: An Unexpected Evil
6064632019860586500.description: Escape the Citadel with the Dragon Egg
more: It's a Dragon Egg! The Orb of Ultimate Essence has been revealed to be an ancient dragon egg. The Anceint fiend, Cerebrak, was trying to tap its powers. He was thwarted and now the Dragon Egg must returned to someone that might keep it secured from evil.

6064633101388546049.title: Oracle of Time
6064633101388546049.description: A Faint Echo from the past speaks in riddles.
more: There are answers to the mystery of the great statue in the Sandsquall, and they rest in the hidden tomb at the foot of the figure's flowing gown. The crypt holds the whispers of a forgotten past, and seekers will find their spiritual journey will bring them here to seek an audience with the gods.
